Title: Interview with Zeng Yucheng: Why should we reflect on the immigration tide and urge the central government to try to win back the hearts of Hong Kong people _ Hong Kong 01 _ Political situation
Content: By: Lin Jian Last updated: 2021-02-08 07: 00 "As a government, whether it is the central government or the SAR, it should also be realistic and analytical, why will more people leave during this period?"  Britain ’ s latest BNO expansion plan has triggered renewed debate between China and the UK.  Chairman of the Democratic Alliance for the Betterment of Hong Kong (DAB) and former President of the Legislative Council, Jasper Tsang, was interviewed by "Hong Kong 01" and talked about the political situation, immigration and other issues.  Jasper Tsang believes that in order for one country, two systems to be stable and far-reaching, at least two issues must be resolved first, including deep-seated social and economic issues, and the controversy over political reform.  No matter how much they dislike the opposition and cannot deny that they represent a considerable part of the voice of Hong Kong people, it is necessary for the government to create a good communication environment and jointly resolve disputes, no matter how difficult it is.  He also believes that not all opposition parties are “not patriots ” and that there are still some who can come together to discuss Hong Kong ’ s way out.  As for immigration, Jasper Tsang believes that the UK only wants to deal with China on the issue of the Hong Kong National Security Law through the BNO expansion plan, and attract Hong Kong talent and capital, and the so-called "historical responsibility" has nothing to do with it.  But he said he would look at the flow of migrants with a sense of normalcy and reflect deeply on where these Hong Kong people want to leave.  He called on the SAR and the central government to win back the confidence of the majority of Hong Kong people in one country, two systems as soon as possible.  Focus on the practice of one country, two systems: When will there be a "soft hand" when the "hard hand" has been done?  Throughout the interview, Mr Tsang talked about the political future of Hong Kong in a rather heavy tone.  Tsang said that in the 23 and a half years since the reunification, there are some phenomena that everyone has seen that the practice of one country, two systems, whether it is the role of the central government, or the relationship between the central government and the SAR, has undergone great changes in the past.  So the first question he asked was: "All those who care about the future of Hong Kong, and the Central Government, and those who care about the practice of one country, two systems, have to explore, if today we have entered a new mode of practice of one country, two systems, is this a normal situation that makes the practice of one country, two systems far away?"  Is the situation in Hong Kong, as we have seen since the implementation of the National Security Law, that most Hong Kong people will feel confident in one country, two systems if it continues? ”  He mentioned that after the implementation of the National Security Law in Hong Kong, some street violence and acts that hit the bottom line of one country have indeed converged, but if one country, two systems are to be stable, it must also win the support of the majority of Hong Kong people, and this "remains to be studied": "I believe that most Hong Kong people have a negative attitude towards acts of social order and Hong Kong independence. But then everyone will see whether the situation in Hong Kong will continue to be like this." Zeng Yucheng pointed out that recently, when talking with many friends about the political situation in Hong Kong, they will ask a question: The central government has done a good job in Hong Kong's "hard hand" and has been effective, when will there be a "soft hand" to win back the hearts of Hong Kong people and heartfelt support for one country, two systems?  In principle, I agree with the "01" advocate for social and economic structural reform, and believe that there are at least two deep-seated contradictions that must be dealt with in the way out of Hong Kong's political and social situation.  First, the serious inequity of society.  He pointed out that the gap between the rich and the poor has widened rather than narrowed in the more than 20 years since the reunification, so he agreed in principle that Hong Kong must usher in a major reform, and the government's governance thinking needs to change: "Simply put, it is to 'turn to the left' and change the set of 'positive non-intervention', 'big market small government' and 'far-right capitalism' left by the British people."  Second, Jasper Tsang believes that reconciling the contradictions in Hong Kong society has never been able to evade the political controversy.  Articles 45 and 68 of the Basic Law stipulate that the ultimate goal is to elect the Chief Executive and the legislature by universal suffrage.  The final goal of universal suffrage is still to be achieved unless an authoritative person says that "it was written wrong in the drafting of the year" and raises the issue of political system, the topic will inevitably fall to political reform and universal suffrage disputes.  Former Chief Executive Leung Chun-ying, Vice Chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC) and former Chief Executive of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), raised the "Chief Executive's Discussion" during an interview with "Hong Kong 01" earlier, which caused political debate.  Mr Tsang, who seems to have shown little interest in these debates, reiterated only one key point: Article 45 of the Basic Law stipulates that the method for selecting the Chief Executive shall be based on the "actual situation and the principle of gradual and orderly progress" with the ultimate goal of "electing the Chief Executive by universal suffrage after nomination by a broadly representative nominating committee in accordance with democratic procedures".  If someone really believes that the “actual situation ” in Hong Kong has changed and it is not worth pursuing this goal, or even going back, the government needs to come out and make it clear.  "Unless I hear authoritative people and central leaders come out and say that we were wrong when we wrote the Basic Law, universal suffrage is not a good system.  One day no one denies this, it is the ultimate goal of the Basic Law, that is to accept, the drafter tells us that he thinks universal suffrage is a good thing.  Recently, some articles came out and said, “It ’ s outdated, and I still think the election is good, how is the United States now? ” If so, please ask the authoritative person in the central government to tell us,“ Sorry, we made a mistake at that time. ”  Mr Leung's earlier suggestion of "consultation" caused political controversy.  (Photo) Call on the Central Authorities, the SAR Government to take the initiative to re-open the door of communication with the democrats. Tsang admitted that with the political energy of the current SAR Government, it is more difficult to push forward the political reform plan, but believes that as a government, it is responsible for dialogue with people from different camps as far as possible to find where there is room for discussion.  "Of course you can say that it is the opposition itself that does not accept the 8.31 framework, but it is your responsibility to re-establish the dialogue channel."  Have you tried it? "  He mentioned that there have been private exchanges with some pan-democrats, and the other side also admitted that if the political reality is to restart the political reform, it must also be based on the 8.31 decision, but it was only during the 2014 Umbrella Movement and the 2015 voting political reform, and it was impossible to support the political reform under the 8.31 framework at that time.  However, today, after the enactment of the National Security Law, political reform is still a potential starting point for political contradictions, and both the SAR and the central government have the responsibility to actively establish communication channels with the unorganized camps and unite all those who can be united.  “You can ’ t deny the fact that a significant number of Hong Kong people still support these unformed factions, even if they fully accept the National Security Law and all the decisions of the Standing Committee of the National People ’ s Congress, and believe that some pan-democrats are not patriotic and cannot be given the opportunity to enter politics, does it mean that they (the citizens) all support the establishment? ”  Therefore, Jasper Zeng believes that the central government and the SAR government must first establish a sense of communication with the democrats, before it is expected to resolve political differences: "Restarting political reform is not like a door, saying that it is very windy outside, sitting here and waiting, to open the door to restart political reform without wind, not so, now we must start doing things."  Maybe the first time, the second time, the other side will "bang" shut the door and kick you out, don't talk to you, but still have to continue knocking on the door? "」  He also believes that even if some extreme radicals are "not saved", but they believe that among the democrats, there are many people who hope that one country, two systems can be successfully implemented, and that the country is good for Hong Kong, and they can unite, and they do not think that all the democrats are "anti-China and Hong Kong". Billy believes that these figures are not exaggerated, because Hong Kong immigrant families generally have higher asset values, plus consumption and work, together with income tax, will definitely bring substantial long-term economic benefits to the UK.  The report also said that only 167,000 people originally held BNO before July 2019, but in August 2020, it has increased to 612,000, reflecting a sharp increase in the number of BNO applications after the anti-extradition campaign, which is estimated to have increased to 733,000 by the end of 2020.  After the Hong Kong government implemented the National Security Law in Hong Kong in July last year, the British government immediately announced the BNO resettlement policy, which is eligible for 2.9 million Hong Kong residents, 2.3 million relatives, and 187,000 BNO dependants aged between 18 and 23.  Based on figures from the Hong Kong Immigration Department, David Webb, an independent stock reviewer, concluded that between 1 July 2020 and 8 January 2021, there were 115,000 net outbound Hong Kong residents, accounting for about 1.5% of Hong Kong ’ s 7.5 million population. Content: British and French officials said they had rescued a total of 40 asylum-seekers, including several children, in separate operations in the English Channel on Tuesday morning. Content: According to a new report by the federal government ’ s spending watchdog, the number of refugee applications received in Canada is on the rise, and the processing system suffers from long delays and lack of criminal review. Title: Refugee crisis: France and Britain strengthen border surveillance to stop migrants crossing the Channel
Content: France and the United Kingdom have signed a new agreement to end illegal immigration through the English Channel.  In recent months, with an increasing number of migrants trying to reach the British coast illegally, the English Channel has become one of the most dangerous crossings for asylum seekers.  Since the beginning of the year, seven people, including a family of five, have drowned while crossing the English Channel.  Britain ’ s interior minister, Priti Patel, announced on Saturday that the French and British governments had reached an agreement to combat migrant smuggling and stop illegal immigration through the Channel.  Britain ’ s interior minister and his French counterpart, Gerald Darmann, have signed the agreement, stressing that they intend to make it impossible for asylum seekers to cross the English Channel, which has reached more than 8,000 this year.  Priti Patel said that as part of the agreement, the French government has committed to doubling the number of its coast guard patrols in the area by December 1 to stop migrant boats in the Channel, and to use new equipment such as drones and radar to identify people trying to cross the Channel to reach the British coast.  Britain ’ s interior minister expressed his satisfaction with the signing of the agreement, saying: “This agreement will make it possible for both France and Britain to make it impossible for migrants to cross the Channel. ”  Signing a new 😍 😍 😍 😍 covenant to tackle small boat crossings.  There will be an increase in surveillance with cuttingedge tech introduce greater security at ports Ensure accommodation for migrants in France https: / / t.co / vjG1KiTkep pic.twitter.com / COJ1jncjcjitC — i Patel (@ pritipatel) November 28, 2020 According to AFP, the two countries have agreed to spend 31.4 million euros on the joint project.  In recent months, the number of migrants attempting to cross the English Channel illegally has increased dramatically.  News of the sinking of boats carrying refugees, which killed four people last year and killed seven this year, including a family of five, has made the Channel a dangerous crossroads for migrants and has severely affected public opinion.  Following the incident, the British government accused France of not doing enough to stop refugees from crossing the Channel.  In September, French authorities said they had blocked 1,300 migrants trying to cross the English Channel.  Between January 1 and August 31, some 6,200 asylum seekers, wearing life jackets and using a variety of inflatable boats, paddles and kayaks provided by smugglers, tried to reach the British coast by illegally crossing the English Channel.  On October 27, following the capsizing of the boat carrying refugees, the majority of whom were Iranian nationals, the 35-year-old Rasoul Irannejad, his wife Shiva Mohammad Panahi, two children aged 6 and 9, and their 15-month-old baby, who were from Sardasht and were trying to cross the Channel from France to Britain, drowned and died.  One of the first asylum seekers to drown in the English Channel in 2019 was Mitra, a 31-year-old Iranian girl with a master ’ s degree in psychology who, along with 19 Iranian and Iraqi refugees, including seven children, boarded a boat for the UK on August 9.  Every year, thousands of people from the Middle East and African countries try to reach Britain through the English Channel.  The Channel, which lies between France and Britain, has seen a dramatic increase in small boats carrying refugees to Britain since 1918, in which a number of refugees have been involved in accidents and some have died. Title: And how many of them are in the kingdom?
Content: Photo copyright Lewis Morris Image caption In recent weeks, groups of asylum seekers have taken small boats off the coast of the UK, according to BBC News, 230 people have tried to reach the UK in small boats crossing the English Channel since the beginning of November.  British Interior Minister Sajid Javid called the incident a "serious incident."  He says that while the UK has commitments to help and support genuine refugees, it is not willing or willing to allow reckless criminals to reap the benefits that belong to the most vulnerable people in the international community.  But how many people have actually applied for asylum by sea in recent weeks?  The British Interior Ministry declined to provide detailed information.  But if all of them have applied for asylum, they would still be equal to the number of people who apply for asylum in the UK every three days on average.  How many asylum seekers are there?  In 2017, 26,350 asylum applications were filed in the UK.  In comparison to other European countries in the same period, 198,255 asylum applications were filed in Germany, 126,550 in Italy and 91,70 in France.  Of these, 21,290 cases have been decided, with 31.8% receiving some form of support.  The UK offers asylum to people who fear being prosecuted in their home country because of their race, religion, nationality, political opinions and factors such as sexual orientation and are unable to live in their home country.  If the asylum application is accepted, people will be allowed to live and work in the UK for five years, after which they will be able to apply for permanent residence.  Not much is known about how the asylum seekers made their way to the UK, but a report from the Home Office ’ s Migration Advisory Committee released in May 2018 estimated that they were “sneaking in ”.  This includes people arriving either by boat to the British coast or being smuggled onto ships or trucks.  Between 2016-2017, the number of these people was 2,366, with the number reduced to 1,832 in 2017-2018.  The Ministry of Interior ’ s report did not say the proportion of these people who applied for asylum.  Which countries are asylum seekers from?  Last year, Iranians were the largest group of asylum seekers in Britain.  In recent days, it has been reported that most of the people who crossed the Channel are Iranians.  Of the 2,690 Iranian asylum seekers, 47 percent received asylum in the first stage of the decision.  These statistics show that the success of Iranian asylum applications is higher than the average number of asylum seekers, or that Iranian asylum seekers have a higher chance of being accepted than other nationalities.  These statistics relate to cases in which a final decision has been made.  Others are in a “wait or wait ” situation.  At the end of last year, 24,557 people were waiting for the outcome of their asylum application, 42 percent of whom had been waiting more than six months.  Rejected asylum applications are usually admissible in court, and people who are rejected often appeal.  Of the 14,149 appeals filed in 2017, 5,222, a third of the appeals court cases, resulted in a breach of the Migration and Asylum Service ’ s initial decision. Title: UN: EU to Blame for Deaths of Migrants in Mediterranean Sea
Content: The United Nations has been implicated in the deaths of migrants in the Mediterranean because of its refusal to respond to calls for emergency relief, its refusal to meet humanitarian rescue efforts and its push to return them to Libya.  In its 37-page report, the UN said the number of migrant deaths this year on the sea route had so far reached 632.  The United Nations has described the incident as a “large-scale humanitarian tragedy. ”  Thousands of migrants and refugees, including from African countries, make long and risky voyages through Libya each year in hopes of getting to Europe and living a better life.  They often use small, inflatable boats to cross this dangerous path.  The report concluded that the lack of protection for migrants “is not a sad anomaly, but rather a consequence of the policies, decisions and actions of Libyan authorities, EU members, institutions and other actors.  The European Union has not only reduced the search and rescue operations of migrants in Mediterranean waters, but its governments have each hindered the rescue operations of humanitarian organizations with their own administrative and criminal proceedings.  Migrants told the UN Human Rights Office there were also efforts to "repatriate migrants at sea", which would return ships carrying migrants from international waters to Libya with the help of European helicopters.  The report is based on interviews with 80 migrants between January 2019 and December 2020.  According to them, some have faced interception operations by Libyan officials and their lives are in danger.  Some boats have been shot down, causing boats to capsize or forcing migrants to jump into the sea.  Most of the migrants returned to Libya face exploitation and ill-treatment.  Commenting on the report, UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Michelle Bachelet called for urgent reforms in the search and rescue policies and actions taken by Libya, the European Union and its member states to ensure that such policies and measures are complied with international law.  The real tragedy is that it is preventable to prevent the suffering and deaths of migrants on the current Mediterranean route.  The United Nations has called on European countries to use more effective and efficient mechanisms to address the wave of migrants and refugees.  The Guardian previously revealed that European countries used brutal methods to stop the passage of almost 40,000 refugees during the coronavirus epidemic, resulting in 2,000 deaths.

Title: 39 'Iranian' refugees detained on Britain's southeast coast
Content: Sean Gallup / Getty Images Image caption One of the boats normally used by asylum seekers to cross the Channel to the UK, four boats carrying 39 Iranian refugees were taken off Sunday, November 17, at separate events off Britain's southeast coast.  The British Interior Ministry confirmed that all of the asylum seekers identified themselves as “Iranian ”.  The first boat, which had nine people on board, took off at 4: 40 a.m. yesterday, while the second, with five people on board, reached the British coast at around 6 a.m.  According to the Coast Guard and Kent County Police, a boat with 11 people on board was seized at around 7 a.m. and a half hour later another boat with 14 people was taken off the coast of the UK.  As soon as they received a message of help from the boats, rescue helicopters, as well as rescue boats from the ports of Dover, Dunness and Hastings, as well as two coast guard vessels, took action to rescue the passengers.  A Home Office spokesman said: "Crossing the canal by these small boats is extremely dangerous.  For those who have gone through such a journey, their lives and their loved ones are at risk. ”  According to the British Home Office, over the past two years Iranian citizens have applied for asylum more than any other country in the UK.  In 2017, about 9% of all 26,350 asylum applications were submitted by Iranians. passages.title: The world ’ s largest aircraft flew for the first time.
passages.passage: The world ’ s largest aircraft, after years of work, flew over the desert north of Los Angeles for the first time on Saturday.  It uses six Boeing engines and has a wingspan of 385 feet (more than 117 meters), making it the world ’ s largest aircraft.  Jane Floyd, CEO of Stratolaunch Systems, told a news conference after the flight: “We finally did it.  It was an exciting time to see this bird fly. ”  Stratolaunch was founded in 2011 by Paul Allen, one of the founders of Microsoft.  But he died last October at the age of 65 and was unable to accompany his crew at the moment when the giant bird would fly.  Jane Floyd continued, “I ’ ve been visualizing this moment in my mind for years, but I never thought Paul wasn ’ t there. ”  The world ’ s largest aircraft soared to 17,000 feet in its first test flight, reaching a top speed of 189 miles per hour.  The plane is 238 feet (72.5 meters) long and weighs half a million pounds (more than 226,000 kg).  The plane also has two cabins, but only one is used during flight.  The plane was part of a larger plan by Stratolaunch to simplify the journey to low Earth orbit.  Paul Allen wrote a few years ago that providing access to low Earth orbit would have many benefits, including sending more satellites that would enable us to better understand why our climate patterns are changing.  Sources: CNN, USA Today; CNN

passages.title: World's Largest Aircraft Completes Second Test Flight, Expected to Test Launch Ultrasound in Two Years
passages.passage: (Reuters) - The world ’ s largest aircraft, the Roc, has successfully completed its second test flight. (Reuters) - The US aerospace company Stratolaunch Systems announced that the world ’ s largest aircraft, the Roc, has completed its second test flight on April 29, 2021, two years after its first test flight.  At 10: 00 a.m. EST on April 29 (10: 00 p.m. Taiwan time on April 29), Stratolaunch ’ s ultra-large aircraft successfully completed its second test flight at the Mojave Space Launch Center in California, USA, flying at an altitude of 14,000 feet (about 4.267 kilometers) and a top speed of 320 kilometers per hour, with a total flight time of 3 hours and 14 minutes.  Stratolaunch is pleased with the results of this test flight, which is intended to confirm the aircraft ’ s performance and capacity, as well as to review the results of a series of previous improvements.  Please continue reading...  The world ’ s largest aircraft, known as the Roc, is reportedly built with six engines and has a wingspan of 117 meters, longer than the length of a standard American football stadium (110 meters).  "Roc" was originally designed as a "small satellite launch platform", hoping to launch a rocket at an altitude of about 10 kilometers to send a satellite directly into space orbit. In the future, it is planned to be used as a launch platform for a hypersonic spacecraft.  In response to the successful completion of the test flight, Stratolaunch insiders said it was a major milestone in the development of "ultra-sonic" flight services.  It is reported that Stratolaunch is currently developing a reusable Talon-A polar sonic aircraft with a maximum speed of 6 Mach (more than 5 times the speed of sound), which can provide about 1 minute of polar sonic flight, and plans to carry Talon-A with "Roc" and ignite its liquid rocket booster in the air to launch and take off. passages.title: Pandora ’ s Box – In the United States for the first time rolled out of the hangar the largest aircraft in the world (PHOTOS, VIDEO)
passages.passage: May 31, 2017 in Mojave (California) took place the roll-out of the almost completed construction of the Stratolaunch Model 351 carrier aircraft (also sometimes referred to as "Roc", in fact, the official name has not yet been assigned) of the aerospace system "air launch" Stratolaunch, created by the American company Stratolaunch Systems (as part of Vulcan Aerospace Corporation). The BMPD blog.  Rolling out of the carrier aircraft Stratolaunch Model 351 aerospace system "air start" Stratolaunch American company Stratolaunch Systems.  Mojave (California), 31.05.2017 (c) Stratolaunch Systems The built twin-body Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft is the largest aircraft in history, having a wingspan of 117 m and a length of 73 m. The maximum take-off weight should be 590 tons, with a suspended payload weight of 230 tons.  Thus, the Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft in wingspan exceeds the former largest aircraft in the world, the Soviet An-225 "Mriya" (which has a wingspan of 88.4 m), although the An-225 retains an advantage in length (84 m) and maximum take-off weight (640 tons).  The Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft is equipped with six twin-circuit Pratt & Whitney PW4056 turbojet engines with a thrust of 25 tons, removed from two decommissioned Boeing 747-400 aircraft.  The landing gear of the aircraft is 28-wheel, take-off distance with full load should be calculated to be 3800 m. The maximum range of the aircraft with full load will not exceed 3700 km.  The aircraft is designed to be used as a carrier for the aerospace system Stratolaunch, created by the American company Stratolaunch Systems, founded by co-founder Microsot Paul Allen and the famous aircraft designer Bert Rutan (who acted as the actual chief designer of the aircraft) (since 2015 Stratolaunch Systems is a subsidiary of the corporation created by the same Paul Allen Vulcan Aerospace).  The aircraft is designed to launch space launch vehicles using the "air launch" method, which will be carried out from an altitude of approximately 10,500 m. The launch vehicle should be suspended under the central part of the wing between the fuselages.  In the course of design and construction, the SpaceX Falcon 9 Air and Orbital ATK Pegasus II launch vehicles were successively replaced as payload options, and now only the long-known Orbital ATK Pegasus XL light launch vehicle used for “air launches ” from“ conventional ” aircraft in the United States since 1990 is considered as such (starting mass of 23.2 tons, payload mass load of 443 kg), and for which there was no need to create such a giant carrier - although the possibility of carrying and launching from it in one flight up to three Pegasus XL launch vehicles is claimed.  In light of this, the outlook for Stratolaunch is still uncertain.  In 2014, the notorious Sierra Nevada Corporation announced the development of a smaller version of the project of its lightweight manned shuttle Dream Chaser (previously rejected by NASA), which was to be launched using an unnamed launch vehicle developed by the Orbital ATK.  However, there is no information about the development of this project in relation to Stratolaunch.  During the launch vehicle roll-out ceremony on May 31, Stratolauch Systems CEO Joan Floyd said that the company would "actively explore a wide range of launch vehicles, allowing us to provide more flexibility for customers."  Rolling out of the carrier aircraft Stratolaunch Model 351 aerospace system "air start" Stratolaunch American company Stratolaunch Systems.  The Stratolaunch Model 351 was designed and built under the contract of Stratolaunch Systems by Scaled Composites, founded by Bert Rutan and now owned by Northrop Grumman Corporation.  The project was announced in December 2011.  The construction of the aircraft was carried out in a specially built for this purpose in 2012 in Mojave giant hangar.  The scheme of the intended use of the aircraft carrier Stratolaunch Model 351 of the aerospace system "air launch" Stratolaunch American company Stratolaunch Systems (c) Stratolaunch Systems The program is lagging behind in terms of about two years.  Currently, the beginning of flight tests of the carrier aircraft is scheduled for the end of 2017, and the first demonstration space launch from it - in 2019.  The start of commercial launches will be possible in this case from 2020. passages.title: The world ’ s largest aircraft can launch three rockets for the first time.
passages.passage: Stratolaunch Systems created the world ’ s largest aircraft and debuted on May 31 at the Mojave Space Station in California. (Photo / Stratolaunch Systems) The airborne giant has 28 wheels.  Stratolaunch Systems (Stratolaunch Systems), founded by Microsoft co-founder Paul Allen, announced on May 31 that the world ’ s largest aircraft will be launched for the first time at the Mojave Air and Space Port in California.  According to SPACENEWS and CNN, the huge object has a double body, a wingspan of more than 117 meters, a net weight of 226,800 kg, a maximum fuel load of 113,400 kg, and an external weight of 250,000 kg.  It has 28 wheels in addition to six engines used in the Boeing 747.  The company was originally set up in late 2011 to launch the mid-size SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, but as the two companies parted ways a year later, Stratolaunch then signed a contract with Orbital Sciences Corp, now known as Orbital ATK, to launch the mid-size rocket.  However, due to the increasing need to launch small satellites, Stratolaunch is now focusing on providing related services.  Allen ’ s newly unveiled baby can launch up to three Pegasus XL small rockets with just one flight.  Stratosphere Launch Systems said in a statement that since this is the world ’ s first new aircraft, it is expected that the giant will fly as early as 2019 after thorough testing for the safety of the pilot and crew.  It will begin with a series of ground tests, including refueling tests, with six tanks on board. The refueling mechanism will be tested separately and whether oil leaks will occur.  Stratolaunch is working on technology to reduce launch costs, and its CEO, Jean Floyd, believes they have shown results.  He pointed out that Allen ’ s motivation for investing is not to make big money, but to change the human environment.  Stratolaunch ’ s world ’ s largest aircraft can launch three small rockets at a time. (Photo / Stratolaunch Systems) The world ’ s largest aircraft, nicknamed Roc, can carry a rocket weighing up to 110 tons to an altitude of nearly 11,000 meters in the stratosphere to launch the rocket. (Photo / Stratolaunch Systems) The aircraft can carry a 110-ton rocket from the ground to 35,000 feet (nearly 11,000 meters) in the stratosphere, and then fire the rocket, launch it out of the atmosphere, and then send satellites into low Earth orbit.  Air-launched rockets have advantages and disadvantages compared to ground-launched rockets.  The advantage is that the air-launched rocket can avoid the dense atmosphere on the surface, greatly reducing the thrust / lift required for the rocket to enter the orbit, thus reducing the cost.  Overall, this launch method can quickly launch a launch object into space at a lower cost, without the need for complex launch site equipment.  In addition, the research of air-launched rocket technology has great military value.  The disadvantage of air-launched rockets is that during take-off, liftoff and flight, the rocket may be accidentally damaged, which increases the uncertainty of the launch.  SpaceX founder Elon Musk believes that the advantages of an air-launched rocket are not enough to make up for its shortcomings. “From SpaceX ’ s point of view, to launch a rocket with a huge aircraft, or to increase the first stage capacity of the rocket by 5%? I will choose the latter. ”

Thus, the Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft in wingspan exceeds the former largest aircraft in the world, the Soviet An-225 "Mriya" (which has a wingspan of 88.4 m), although the An-225 retains an advantage in length (84 m) and maximum take-off weight (640 tons). Title: The world ’ s largest aircraft can launch three rockets for the first time.
Content: Stratolaunch Systems created the world ’ s largest aircraft and debuted on May 31 at the Mojave Space Station in California. (Photo / Stratolaunch Systems) The airborne giant has 28 wheels.  Stratolaunch Systems (Stratolaunch Systems), founded by Microsoft co-founder Paul Allen, announced on May 31 that the world ’ s largest aircraft will be launched for the first time at the Mojave Air and Space Port in California.  According to SPACENEWS and CNN, the huge object has a double body, a wingspan of more than 117 meters, a net weight of 226,800 kg, a maximum fuel load of 113,400 kg, and an external weight of 250,000 kg.  It has 28 wheels in addition to six engines used in the Boeing 747.  The company was originally set up in late 2011 to launch the mid-size SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, but as the two companies parted ways a year later, Stratolaunch then signed a contract with Orbital Sciences Corp, now known as Orbital ATK, to launch the mid-size rocket.  However, due to the increasing need to launch small satellites, Stratolaunch is now focusing on providing related services.  Allen ’ s newly unveiled baby can launch up to three Pegasus XL small rockets with just one flight.  Stratosphere Launch Systems said in a statement that since this is the world ’ s first new aircraft, it is expected that the giant will fly as early as 2019 after thorough testing for the safety of the pilot and crew.  It will begin with a series of ground tests, including refueling tests, with six tanks on board. The refueling mechanism will be tested separately and whether oil leaks will occur.  Stratolaunch is working on technology to reduce launch costs, and its CEO, Jean Floyd, believes they have shown results.  He pointed out that Allen ’ s motivation for investing is not to make big money, but to change the human environment.  Stratolaunch ’ s world ’ s largest aircraft can launch three small rockets at a time. Air-launched rockets have advantages and disadvantages compared to ground-launched rockets.  The advantage is that the air-launched rocket can avoid the dense atmosphere on the surface, greatly reducing the thrust / lift required for the rocket to enter the orbit, thus reducing the cost.  Overall, this launch method can quickly launch a launch object into space at a lower cost, without the need for complex launch site equipment.  In addition, the research of air-launched rocket technology has great military value.  The disadvantage of air-launched rockets is that during take-off, liftoff and flight, the rocket may be accidentally damaged, which increases the uncertainty of the launch.  SpaceX founder Elon Musk believes that the advantages of an air-launched rocket are not enough to make up for its shortcomings. “From SpaceX ’ s point of view, to launch a rocket with a huge aircraft, or to increase the first stage capacity of the rocket by 5%? Title: The world ’ s largest aircraft flew for the first time.
Content: The world ’ s largest aircraft, after years of work, flew over the desert north of Los Angeles for the first time on Saturday.  It uses six Boeing engines and has a wingspan of 385 feet (more than 117 meters), making it the world ’ s largest aircraft.  Jane Floyd, CEO of Stratolaunch Systems, told a news conference after the flight: “We finally did it.  It was an exciting time to see this bird fly. ”  Stratolaunch was founded in 2011 by Paul Allen, one of the founders of Microsoft.  But he died last October at the age of 65 and was unable to accompany his crew at the moment when the giant bird would fly.  Jane Floyd continued, “I ’ ve been visualizing this moment in my mind for years, but I never thought Paul wasn ’ t there. ”  The world ’ s largest aircraft soared to 17,000 feet in its first test flight, reaching a top speed of 189 miles per hour.  The plane is 238 feet (72.5 meters) long and weighs half a million pounds (more than 226,000 kg).  The plane also has two cabins, but only one is used during flight.  The plane was part of a larger plan by Stratolaunch to simplify the journey to low Earth orbit.  Paul Allen wrote a few years ago that providing access to low Earth orbit would have many benefits, including sending more satellites that would enable us to better understand why our climate patterns are changing. Title: Pandora ’ s Box – In the United States for the first time rolled out of the hangar the largest aircraft in the world (PHOTOS, VIDEO)
Content: May 31, 2017 in Mojave (California) took place the roll-out of the almost completed construction of the Stratolaunch Model 351 carrier aircraft (also sometimes referred to as "Roc", in fact, the official name has not yet been assigned) of the aerospace system "air launch" Stratolaunch, created by the American company Stratolaunch Systems (as part of Vulcan Aerospace Corporation). The BMPD blog.  Rolling out of the carrier aircraft Stratolaunch Model 351 aerospace system "air start" Stratolaunch American company Stratolaunch Systems.  Mojave (California), 31.05.2017 (c) Stratolaunch Systems The built twin-body Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft is the largest aircraft in history, having a wingspan of 117 m and a length of 73 m. The maximum take-off weight should be 590 tons, with a suspended payload weight of 230 tons.  Thus, the Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft in wingspan exceeds the former largest aircraft in the world, the Soviet An-225 "Mriya" (which has a wingspan of 88.4 m), although the An-225 retains an advantage in length (84 m) and maximum take-off weight (640 tons).  The Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft is equipped with six twin-circuit Pratt & Whitney PW4056 turbojet engines with a thrust of 25 tons, removed from two decommissioned Boeing 747-400 aircraft.  The landing gear of the aircraft is 28-wheel, take-off distance with full load should be calculated to be 3800 m. The maximum range of the aircraft with full load will not exceed 3700 km.  The aircraft is designed to be used as a carrier for the aerospace system Stratolaunch, created by the American company Stratolaunch Systems, founded by co-founder Microsot Paul Allen and the famous aircraft designer Bert Rutan (who acted as the actual chief designer of the aircraft) (since 2015 Stratolaunch Systems is a subsidiary of the corporation created by the same Paul Allen Vulcan Aerospace).  The aircraft is designed to launch space launch vehicles using the "air launch" method, which will be carried out from an altitude of approximately 10,500 m. The launch vehicle should be suspended under the central part of the wing between the fuselages.  In the course of design and construction, the SpaceX Falcon 9 Air and Orbital ATK Pegasus II launch vehicles were successively replaced as payload options, and now only the long-known Orbital ATK Pegasus XL light launch vehicle used for “air launches ” from“ conventional ” aircraft in the United States since 1990 is considered as such (starting mass of 23.2 tons, payload mass load of 443 kg), and for which there was no need to create such a giant carrier - although the possibility of carrying and launching from it in one flight up to three Pegasus XL launch vehicles is claimed.  In light of this, the outlook for Stratolaunch is still uncertain.  In 2014, the notorious Sierra Nevada Corporation announced the development of a smaller version of the project of its lightweight manned shuttle Dream Chaser (previously rejected by NASA), which was to be launched using an unnamed launch vehicle developed by the Orbital ATK.  However, there is no information about the development of this project in relation to Stratolaunch.  During the launch vehicle roll-out ceremony on May 31, Stratolauch Systems CEO Joan Floyd said that the company would "actively explore a wide range of launch vehicles, allowing us to provide more flexibility for customers."  Rolling out of the carrier aircraft Stratolaunch Model 351 aerospace system "air start" Stratolaunch American company Stratolaunch Systems.  The Stratolaunch Model 351 was designed and built under the contract of Stratolaunch Systems by Scaled Composites, founded by Bert Rutan and now owned by Northrop Grumman Corporation.  The project was announced in December 2011.  The construction of the aircraft was carried out in a specially built for this purpose in 2012 in Mojave giant hangar.  The scheme of the intended use of the aircraft carrier Stratolaunch Model 351 of the aerospace system "air launch" Stratolaunch American company Stratolaunch Systems (c) Stratolaunch Systems The program is lagging behind in terms of about two years.  Currently, the beginning of flight tests of the carrier aircraft is scheduled for the end of 2017, and the first demonstration space launch from it - in 2019.  The start of commercial launches will be possible in this case from 2020. Title: The world ’ s largest aircraft can launch three rockets for the first time.
Content: Stratolaunch Systems created the world ’ s largest aircraft and debuted on May 31 at the Mojave Space Station in California. (Photo / Stratolaunch Systems) The airborne giant has 28 wheels.  Stratolaunch Systems (Stratolaunch Systems), founded by Microsoft co-founder Paul Allen, announced on May 31 that the world ’ s largest aircraft will be launched for the first time at the Mojave Air and Space Port in California.  According to SPACENEWS and CNN, the huge object has a double body, a wingspan of more than 117 meters, a net weight of 226,800 kg, a maximum fuel load of 113,400 kg, and an external weight of 250,000 kg.  It has 28 wheels in addition to six engines used in the Boeing 747.  The company was originally set up in late 2011 to launch the mid-size SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, but as the two companies parted ways a year later, Stratolaunch then signed a contract with Orbital Sciences Corp, now known as Orbital ATK, to launch the mid-size rocket.  However, due to the increasing need to launch small satellites, Stratolaunch is now focusing on providing related services.  Allen ’ s newly unveiled baby can launch up to three Pegasus XL small rockets with just one flight.  Stratosphere Launch Systems said in a statement that since this is the world ’ s first new aircraft, it is expected that the giant will fly as early as 2019 after thorough testing for the safety of the pilot and crew.  It will begin with a series of ground tests, including refueling tests, with six tanks on board. The refueling mechanism will be tested separately and whether oil leaks will occur.  Stratolaunch is working on technology to reduce launch costs, and its CEO, Jean Floyd, believes they have shown results.  He pointed out that Allen ’ s motivation for investing is not to make big money, but to change the human environment.  Stratolaunch ’ s world ’ s largest aircraft can launch three small rockets at a time. (Photo / Stratolaunch Systems) The world ’ s largest aircraft, nicknamed Roc, can carry a rocket weighing up to 110 tons to an altitude of nearly 11,000 meters in the stratosphere to launch the rocket. (Photo / Stratolaunch Systems) The aircraft can carry a 110-ton rocket from the ground to 35,000 feet (nearly 11,000 meters) in the stratosphere, and then fire the rocket, launch it out of the atmosphere, and then send satellites into low Earth orbit.  Air-launched rockets have advantages and disadvantages compared to ground-launched rockets.  The advantage is that the air-launched rocket can avoid the dense atmosphere on the surface, greatly reducing the thrust / lift required for the rocket to enter the orbit, thus reducing the cost.  Overall, this launch method can quickly launch a launch object into space at a lower cost, without the need for complex launch site equipment.  In addition, the research of air-launched rocket technology has great military value.  The disadvantage of air-launched rockets is that during take-off, liftoff and flight, the rocket may be accidentally damaged, which increases the uncertainty of the launch.  SpaceX founder Elon Musk believes that the advantages of an air-launched rocket are not enough to make up for its shortcomings. “From SpaceX ’ s point of view, to launch a rocket with a huge aircraft, or to increase the first stage capacity of the rocket by 5%? I will choose the latter. ”

passages.passage: An accident in the Tour de France; police in pursuit of the 'reckless woman' 46 minutes ago Image source Gendarmerie du finistere Image caption Police are searching for a woman who caused a bicycle accident French police are searching for a woman whose carelessness made headlines during the Tour de France.  The spectator entered the path of the cyclists with a placard in his hand, and as a result, many athletes crashed and fell to the ground in the first round.  On Saturday, she leaned into the road in the speed section of the race in Brittany, France, holding a placard.  The first cyclist he encountered was German Tony Martin, followed by a significant number of athletes.  Police say they have filed a criminal case for the incident.  According to police, the charge is "deliberate violation of safety regulations and causing injuries that could prevent someone from working for up to three months."  The image of the incident has been widely circulated on social media.  A woman in a yellow coat with a sign in German that reads “Grandma and Grandpa. ”  The woman stands with her back to the group of cyclists and does not notice that they are approaching.  One of the injured cyclists was forced to retire from the Tour de France, and eight other cyclists were suspended by the official doctor.  Police said the woman fled the scene after the incident.  Police have asked witnesses to give their information to officers.  The vice president of the Tour de France also called for legal action against the woman, saying: “We will sue her for her very bad behavior.  We do this so that a small group of people can ’ t ruin a show that ’ s for everyone. ”  France has recently eased some of the restrictions imposed by the coronavirus outbreak, with a sizable population making its way to cyclists to watch races.  The Tour de France is an annual cycling race for men.  It is considered to be the most prestigious bicycle road race in the world.  France hosts the tournament, but sometimes competitions are held in the surrounding countries.

passages.title: Mass blockage at the cycling race "Tour de France" because of the antics of the cheerleader: the girl hit the racers with a poster and ran away
passages.passage: The girl showed the camera a poster with a joke inscription, knocked down the racers on the asphalt and fled from the scene.  45 km before the end of the first stage of the legendary cycling race "Tour de France" there was a massive blockage, as a result of which more than two dozen athletes were injured.  Almost half of the peloton fell, including the main favorites.  The culprit of the accident was a cheerleader who put up a poster with a joke inscription right in front of the riders.  Now she is wanted by the police, who asked witnesses for help through social networks.  The organizers of the race promised her legal proceedings.  "Allez Opi-Omi" The cheerleader intervened in the battle of the strongest riders of the world at the most famous stage race in history at the first stage from Brest to Landerno.  About 45 km before the finish, the girl in blue jeans and a bright yellow jacket jumped from the side of the road and put on camera in front of the athletes a poster with the inscription “Allez Opi-Omi ” (a joke and caressing appeal to grandparents in German, something like“ Go, old men ”).  Driving on the right side of the rider of the team “Jumbo Wisma ” German Tony Martin had no chance to dodge the collision with the poster and fell, which led to a major blockage.  Not escaped this and the main favorites: Slovenes Tadej Pogacar and Primož Roglic.  But they at least cost bruises and abrasions, but Spaniard Mark Soler of “Movistar ” broke the radial bones on both hands.  By some miracle, he reached the finish line, but he will not be able to continue the race.  Like the German Jascha Sutterlin.  Those who continued the Tour de France lost a lot of time.  “We had everything under control, I led the guys on the right side of the road, but crashed into a fan poster.  It all happened very quickly, all of a sudden, almost everyone was on the ground.  Many viewers behave respectfully, but in this case this was not the case, unfortunately.  I hope that there will be no consequences for the health of all the guys who fell into the rubble, ” said Tony Martin.  A year behind bars and a 15,000 euro fine The cheerleader, who became the culprit of the accident, quickly disappeared.  The Gendarmerie Landerno put her on the wanted list and asked for help from witnesses, posting a post on social media.  However, the comments are more negative towards the police than the desire to help find a negligent fan.  The organizers of the Tour de France have already promised that the culprit of the collision is awaiting trial.  “We must not allow a small number of hooligans to spoil the sporting event for participants and fans, ” said Pierre-Yves Tuo, deputy director of the race.  What threatens the offender?  While injured in the accident riders did not submit a statement to the police – a fine of 1500 euros.  But if Soler and Sutterlin write such a statement, the case will be reclassified.  Now the fan is accused that failure to comply with the required security measures led to harm to health.  In the case of a statement from the riders unknown until the violator faces a fine ten times more and up to a year in prison.  The organizers appealed to all fans with a request to observe security measures and even released a special video reminding how dangerous such clashes can be.  There are a lot of fans in the current Tour de France.  And almost no one follows the antiquated rules.  The organizers are ready to turn a blind eye to this, but when the physical safety of athletes is threatened, it is quite another matter.  The athletes themselves also urged fans to be more restrained in the display of emotions, although clashes with fans in cycling are quite regular.  But now it has crossed all boundaries.  “I hope Opi-Omi are proud of you, ” Belgian cyclist Jasper Stuyven wrote on Twitter.  It is wonderful to see that there are so many fans who love our sport and support us.  But please stay on the side of the road, not on the road! ”  The participants of the Tour de France quite cope with the organization of force majeure and without the participation of fans.  At the same first stage, about 8 km before the finish line, Briton Chris Froome forked to the side and organized another blockage, himself and being the main victim.  But serious injuries to athletes were avoided.  The leader in the overall stage race after two stages is the Dutchman Mathieu van der Poole from the Alpesin-Phoenix team.  Russian riders do not participate in the current Tour de France.

Title: Mass blockage at the cycling race "Tour de France" because of the antics of the cheerleader: the girl hit the racers with a poster and ran away
Content: The girl showed the camera a poster with a joke inscription, knocked down the racers on the asphalt and fled from the scene.  45 km before the end of the first stage of the legendary cycling race "Tour de France" there was a massive blockage, as a result of which more than two dozen athletes were injured.  Almost half of the peloton fell, including the main favorites.  The culprit of the accident was a cheerleader who put up a poster with a joke inscription right in front of the riders.  Now she is wanted by the police, who asked witnesses for help through social networks.  The organizers of the race promised her legal proceedings.  "Allez Opi-Omi" The cheerleader intervened in the battle of the strongest riders of the world at the most famous stage race in history at the first stage from Brest to Landerno.  About 45 km before the finish, the girl in blue jeans and a bright yellow jacket jumped from the side of the road and put on camera in front of the athletes a poster with the inscription “Allez Opi-Omi ” (a joke and caressing appeal to grandparents in German, something like“ Go, old men ”).  Driving on the right side of the rider of the team “Jumbo Wisma ” German Tony Martin had no chance to dodge the collision with the poster and fell, which led to a major blockage.  Not escaped this and the main favorites: Slovenes Tadej Pogacar and Primož Roglic.  But they at least cost bruises and abrasions, but Spaniard Mark Soler of “Movistar ” broke the radial bones on both hands.  By some miracle, he reached the finish line, but he will not be able to continue the race.  Like the German Jascha Sutterlin.  Those who continued the Tour de France lost a lot of time.  “We had everything under control, I led the guys on the right side of the road, but crashed into a fan poster.  It all happened very quickly, all of a sudden, almost everyone was on the ground.  Many viewers behave respectfully, but in this case this was not the case, unfortunately.  I hope that there will be no consequences for the health of all the guys who fell into the rubble, ” said Tony Martin.  A year behind bars and a 15,000 euro fine The cheerleader, who became the culprit of the accident, quickly disappeared.  The Gendarmerie Landerno put her on the wanted list and asked for help from witnesses, posting a post on social media.  However, the comments are more negative towards the police than the desire to help find a negligent fan.  The organizers of the Tour de France have already promised that the culprit of the collision is awaiting trial.  “We must not allow a small number of hooligans to spoil the sporting event for participants and fans, ” said Pierre-Yves Tuo, deputy director of the race.  What threatens the offender?  While injured in the accident riders did not submit a statement to the police – a fine of 1500 euros.  But if Soler and Sutterlin write such a statement, the case will be reclassified.  Now the fan is accused that failure to comply with the required security measures led to harm to health.  In the case of a statement from the riders unknown until the violator faces a fine ten times more and up to a year in prison.  The organizers appealed to all fans with a request to observe security measures and even released a special video reminding how dangerous such clashes can be.  There are a lot of fans in the current Tour de France.  And almost no one follows the antiquated rules.  The organizers are ready to turn a blind eye to this, but when the physical safety of athletes is threatened, it is quite another matter.  The athletes themselves also urged fans to be more restrained in the display of emotions, although clashes with fans in cycling are quite regular.  But now it has crossed all boundaries.  “I hope Opi-Omi are proud of you, ” Belgian cyclist Jasper Stuyven wrote on Twitter.  It is wonderful to see that there are so many fans who love our sport and support us.  But please stay on the side of the road, not on the road! ”  The participants of the Tour de France quite cope with the organization of force majeure and without the participation of fans.  At the same first stage, about 8 km before the finish line, Briton Chris Froome forked to the side and organized another blockage, himself and being the main victim.  But serious injuries to athletes were avoided.  The leader in the overall stage race after two stages is the Dutchman Mathieu van der Poole from the Alpesin-Phoenix team.  Russian riders do not participate in the current Tour de France.

passages.title: Tomorrow SpaceX will test the emergency rescue system of the Crew Dragon spacecraft in flight. This is the last major test before the first operational flight with astronauts on board
passages.passage: Tomorrow, January 18, SpaceX intends to make the final major test of Crew Dragon ahead of the long-awaited Demo-2 mission with the first operational flight of a crewed spacecraft to the ISS.  We are talking about those additional tests of the emergency rescue system (SAS) with the shooting of the capsule during the flight.  Of course, the launch will be broadcast online, and those who want to watch the broadcast will find it below in this note.  The carrier rocket itself with the ship is already installed at the site of the SLC-40 complex at Cape Canaveral and is waiting for the countdown; a suitable launch window for the launch of the rocket opens on January 18 at 15: 00 Kyiv time.  SpaceX will have four hours to conduct the launch; assess the weather conditions as favorable and state that the probability of a successful launch is 90%.  Falcon 9 and Crew Dragon went vertical and the crew access arm was extended last night ahead of tomorrow's in-flight demonstration of the spacecraft's launch escape system.  The four-hour launch window opens at 8: 00 a.m.  EST, 13: 00 UTC → https: / / t.co / gtC39uBC7z pic.twitter.com / dS6R3hCgZi — SpaceX (@ SpaceX) January 17, 2020 These tests are not a mandatory part of NASA ’ s Crew Dragon certification program, but SpaceX on its own initiative intends to conduct them to demonstrate the reliability of the SAS and even donate one Falcon 9 rockets - for the purity of the experiment with simulated accident, it is likely to be destroyed during the flight, and the capsule soon after firing parachutes and splashdown in the ocean.  The animation for tomorrow ’ s launch can be seen below.  @ SpaceX's uncrewed in-flight abort test is targeted for 8am ET on Jan. 18.  This test will show that the # CrewDragon can protect astronauts even in the unlikely event of an emergency during launch.  Currently, weather is 90% GO for the demonstration.  https: / / t.co / PgHZol6PQA pic.twitter.com / kWCq7IHiq1 — NASA Commercial Crew (@ Commercial _ Crew) January 15, 2020 Recall that the Crew Dragon ship is equipped with two types of propulsion systems (low and high pressure).  The first with sixteen Draco engines is designed for orbital maneuvers and orientation of the ship in space, and the second with eight SuperDraco engines is responsible for shooting and controlled landing of the rescue capsule in case of an emergency.  The first Pad Abort Test simulated a rocket crash before launch and shot off the capsule from the launch pad SpaceX held back in 2015, and at the end of the year passed static tests of the emergency rescue system Crew Dragon in a new configuration with rupture diaphragm valves in the pressurization tubes instead of titanium valves.  The improvement should prevent the very possibility of a repeat of the scenario that led to the crash in April.  Also not so long ago, in preparation for the Demo-2 mission, SpaceX successfully tested new parachutes for Crew Dragon.  A few weeks ago, Elon Musk shared a video with computer animation of the first manned flight of the Crew Dragon spacecraft to the ISS.  It is hardly worth saying how important for SpaceX and the entire world of cosmonautics is this launch, to which SpaceX has been going for eight long years.  Recall, Crew Dragon is being developed as part of NASA ’ s program to stimulate the development of private ships Commercial Crew Development to send American astronauts to the ISS and ensure independence in this matter from Russia.  After the closure of the Space Shuttle program in 2011, the only means of delivering crews to the International Space Station are the Russian Soyuz spacecraft.  It is noteworthy that on January 20, SpaceX plans to carry out the next launch of Falcon 9, sending into orbit another batch of 60 satellites as part of its own project of a global satellite Internet network of a new generation.  This year, SpaceX plans to begin providing communication services to its first customers, and full network deployment is scheduled for the mid-2020s.  In total, in 2020, SpaceX plans to make from 35 to 38 launches, of which at least 24 in the interests of the Starlink project.

passages.title: SpaceX successfully launches manned space capsule
passages.passage: On Saturday, space exploration technology company SpaceX launched its first crew Dragon, a critical flight to prove to NASA the safety of astronauts in future flights.  The mission, called Demo-1, was launched on a Falcon 9 rocket from the Kennedy Air Center in California.  This space capsule does not carry a human, but a model of an astronaut called Ripley, wearing sensors to measure various indicators of the human body in the space capsule.  This is the first of two SpaceX test flights under NASA ’ s Commercial Crew Program. Demo-2 will be the first to fly with a human pilot, scheduled for July of this year.  According to NASA ’ s plan, SpaceX will be the first company to send astronauts into space since 2011.  NASA Administrator Jim Bridenstine later stated that the successful launch marked a new chapter in American excellence, bringing us once again closer to carrying American astronauts from American soil on American rockets.  Since the retirement of the Space Shuttle in 2011, the United States has been unable to use its own rockets to transport astronauts to space on its own. NASA is working with private companies to develop the future of human spaceflight.  Currently, SpaceX and NASA have a contract value of $2.6 billion, and Boeing is $4.2 billion.

passages.title: SpaceX successfully sent two astronauts into space as part of the Demo-2 mission » DailyTechInfo
passages.passage: On May 30, 2020, at 19: 22 GMT, the famous American space company SpaceX successfully launched a manned mission Demo-2.  The Crew Dragon spacecraft, which now holds two astronauts, Robert Behnken and Douglas Hurley, was launched into space by a Falcon 9 rocket launched from Launch Complex 39A at NASA ’ s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.  The spacecraft is currently in space, performing maneuvers that will lead it to the International Space Station (ISS), docking with which will be made during today, May 31, 2020.Yesterday's launch was made after the first attempt, scheduled for Wednesday last week, was postponed due to the approach of the storm front, carrying strong wind, rain and an increased risk of lightning strike.  By the time of the delayed launch, the weather had improved significantly, but NASA weather forecasters still gave a 50 percent chance of re-carrying the launch.  The Crew Dragon spacecraft successfully entered orbit, which was a mark of two significant events at once.  The Demo-2 mission was the first manned mission launched from the United States since 2011, when NASA retired its fleet of space shuttles.  And the second event was that the Demo-2 mission is the world ’ s first commercial mission, in which a spacecraft with astronauts on board was put into orbit. If the Demo-2 mission is successfully carried out until the very end, then SpaceX will begin to carry out regular flights to the ISS, delivering astronauts and various cargoes back to Earth.  And in conclusion, it should be noted that in the case of a successful docking of the Crew Dragon spacecraft with the space station, astronauts Robert Benken and Douglas Hurley will spend on board it from one to three months, after which they will return to Earth.

passages.title: The launch of the ship Crew Dragon – NASA flight: date, all that is known
passages.passage: Already this week, SpaceX ’ s Crew Dragon spacecraft will go to the ISS as part of the Demo-2 test mission.  The launch will mark the return of the United States to manned flights, which ended with the closure of the Space Shuttle program in 2011.  How the mission will take place and why it is important, we tell in our material.  Channel 24 closely followed the process of preparation for the manned launch of the manned spacecraft Crew Dragon.  We decided to collect all the details and interesting points in one article so that you could get acquainted with the key stages of the mission.  Do not miss the US returning to the ISS: SpaceX and NASA have revealed the details of the historic mission What is happening The United States of America is returning to manned flights to the ISS using its own ships.  Already this week, on May 27, the first ever manned launch of a spacecraft to the ISS, carried out by a private company SpaceX, will take place.  Crew Dragon will have two American astronauts on board.  After launch, the ship docks with the International Space Station at an altitude of 400 kilometers above the surface of the planet.  The astronauts will get to the station, where they will continue their mission, the duration of which is not yet known and will depend on a number of factors, both during the launch and during the flight of the ship until the moment of docking with the ISS.  Despite the fact that the flight is manned, and the mission of astronauts will take a lot of time on the ISS, it is still a test, so it is called Demo-2.  Previously, SpaceX has already tested the ship Crew Dragon, but this time the company will do it for the first time as part of a crewed mission.  The broadcast of the flight will take place on Techno 24.  So visit our website on May 27 at 23: 15.  The start is scheduled for 23: 30 in Kiev.  In addition, the broadcast will be available here: NASA TV: YouTube; SpaceX: YouTube link to the broadcast will be available before launch.  The fact is that the manned launch of Demo-2 will be the first such launch from American soil in almost a decade.  The last manned spacecraft to perform such a mission was the Space Shuttle Atlantis, which landed on July 21, 2011 as part of the STS-135 mission.  After that, the shuttles to the ISS no longer flew, and NASA was forced to buy seats for its astronauts on the Russian Soyuz, which cost the United States a considerable amount.  It is worth paying attention to the fact that after the American shuttles stopped flying, Russia constantly raised the price of seats for American astronauts and other partners on board the Soyuz spacecraft.  As of today, one seat on the Soyuz costs NASA $90 million (in 2010 it cost about $30 million).  The Alpha Centauri portal notes that given the approximate prices of Russian state launch contracts, it turns out that NASA pays the entire ship and the full cost of launching as part of the mission, paying only for one of its astronauts.  According to the report of NASA OIG on the audit of the manned flight program / The Alpha Centauri Here are more interesting facts about the ISS: how to create a research bastion of humanity in space Commercial Crew Program A year before the last flight of the shuttle, NASA initiated the launch of the manned flight program.  Even then, the search for a replacement for space shuttles began, the launches of which were quite expensive for the state.  Then came the idea, which at that time was revolutionary and even strange: the delivery of astronauts to the ISS should be engaged in private space companies.  NASA in this scenario took over the control of the design and preparation for the launch and the payment of seats for astronauts.  Space Shuttle Atlantis 30 minutes after landing in the last flight of the program Finally, in 2014, two companies were selected that will continue to prepare and present manned ships that will be able to carry out the mission.  These companies are Boeing and SpaceX.  As for the first company, the launch of the Boeing Starliner was unsuccessful, despite the fact that the ship landed successfully.  The company was unable to ensure the docking of the ship with the ISS due to a number of errors.  Now Boeing is engaged in fixing all the problems and preparing for a new test launch, but for their money.  Boeing Starliner, after landing SpaceX in March 2020, successfully launched Crew Dragon, which has passed a number of tests and landed proving its ability to ensure the delivery of astronauts to the ISS.  After additional tests and final preparations, the ship was prepared for an important event - a manned launch, which will take place on May 27, 2020.  Crew Crew Dragon To the ISS will go two NASA astronauts: Robert "Bob" Benken and Douglas "Doug" Gurley.  Both of them were test pilots and together in 2000 got to NASA as part of the 18th selection of astronauts.  Robert "Bob" Benken and Douglas "Dag" Gurley / NASA As for Robert Benken, during his time at NASA, he took part in two missions of the shuttle Endeavour: STS-123 (2008) and STS-130 (2010).  As part of these missions, Benken had three spacewalks.  Astronaut Robert Benken During the Demo-2 flight, Robert Benken will take command of the flight stages that will be coordinated by the mission control center.  Douglas Gurley also participated in two missions of the shuttle Endevour on missions STS-127 (2009) and STS-135 (2011).  In both missions, Gurley was a shuttle pilot, and STS-135 was the last mission to complete the space shuttle program.  During the Demo-2 flight, Douglas Hurley will be the commander of the ship and responsible for all procedures related to the launch and landing of the Crew Dragon spacecraft.  As already noted, the launch of the Crew Dragon is scheduled for May 27.  It is worth noting that the mission can still be postponed.  The reasons for this may be, as detected at the last moment technical problems or the weather, which should be favorable not only at the launch site, but also throughout the flight path of the Falcon 9 rocket.  Because in these places must pass the splashdown of the crew, if something went wrong at the time of launch or flight.  The ship Crew Dragon / SpaceX Now it is known that if the launch does not take place on May 27, then it can be postponed both on May 30 and on May 31.  If everything goes according to plan and the ship successfully enters orbit, it will spend about 19 hours there.  This is necessary for additional tests and maneuvers as part of the test – Crew Dragon can get to the ISS much faster.  In orbit, the astronauts will check the operation of all systems, switch to manual control, perform several maneuvers and eventually experience how comfortable Crew Dragon is for sleeping.  Docking with the IDA-2 node of the Harmony module on the ISS is scheduled for May 28 at about 15: 39 UTC (18: 39 Kyiv time).  Before that, the astronauts will approach the ISS and conduct several maneuvers near the station.  It is worth noting that the entire docking process with the ISS will take place automatically.  Astronauts will observe the process and will be able to intercept control in case of an emergency.  After the crew of Crew Dragon will get to the station, he will meet with members of the 63rd expedition - Chris Cassidy, Anatoly Ivanishin and Ivan Wagner.  As noted at the beginning of the material, the duration of stay of astronauts on the ISS is still unknown.  It will finally be determined during the flight, taking into account the state of the Crew Dragon ship and the readiness of the next Crew Dragon capsule, which is already designed for flight as part of the first full-fledged mission.  Let me remind you that despite the manned flight, this is still a test flight.  In addition, NASA expects to keep Demo-2 in orbit for as long as possible.  It is necessary for that.  after returning to finish the certification of the ship and begin preparations for the next mission.  In general, Demo-2 has every chance to stay in orbit for up to 120 days.  Rehearsal of the launch of Demo-2 / SpaceX Here it is worth noting that this limitation is due to the peculiarity of the design of the Crew Dragon. Title: Tomorrow SpaceX will test the emergency rescue system of the Crew Dragon spacecraft in flight. This is the last major test before the first operational flight with astronauts on board
Content: Tomorrow, January 18, SpaceX intends to make the final major test of Crew Dragon ahead of the long-awaited Demo-2 mission with the first operational flight of a crewed spacecraft to the ISS.  We are talking about those additional tests of the emergency rescue system (SAS) with the shooting of the capsule during the flight.  Of course, the launch will be broadcast online, and those who want to watch the broadcast will find it below in this note.  The carrier rocket itself with the ship is already installed at the site of the SLC-40 complex at Cape Canaveral and is waiting for the countdown; a suitable launch window for the launch of the rocket opens on January 18 at 15: 00 Kyiv time.  SpaceX will have four hours to conduct the launch; assess the weather conditions as favorable and state that the probability of a successful launch is 90%.  Falcon 9 and Crew Dragon went vertical and the crew access arm was extended last night ahead of tomorrow's in-flight demonstration of the spacecraft's launch escape system.  The four-hour launch window opens at 8: 00 a.m.  EST, 13: 00 UTC → https: / / t.co / gtC39uBC7z pic.twitter.com / dS6R3hCgZi — SpaceX (@ SpaceX) January 17, 2020 These tests are not a mandatory part of NASA ’ s Crew Dragon certification program, but SpaceX on its own initiative intends to conduct them to demonstrate the reliability of the SAS and even donate one Falcon 9 rockets - for the purity of the experiment with simulated accident, it is likely to be destroyed during the flight, and the capsule soon after firing parachutes and splashdown in the ocean.  The animation for tomorrow ’ s launch can be seen below.  @ SpaceX's uncrewed in-flight abort test is targeted for 8am ET on Jan. 18.  This test will show that the # CrewDragon can protect astronauts even in the unlikely event of an emergency during launch.  Currently, weather is 90% GO for the demonstration.  https: / / t.co / PgHZol6PQA pic.twitter.com / kWCq7IHiq1 — NASA Commercial Crew (@ Commercial _ Crew) January 15, 2020 Recall that the Crew Dragon ship is equipped with two types of propulsion systems (low and high pressure).  The first with sixteen Draco engines is designed for orbital maneuvers and orientation of the ship in space, and the second with eight SuperDraco engines is responsible for shooting and controlled landing of the rescue capsule in case of an emergency.  The first Pad Abort Test simulated a rocket crash before launch and shot off the capsule from the launch pad SpaceX held back in 2015, and at the end of the year passed static tests of the emergency rescue system Crew Dragon in a new configuration with rupture diaphragm valves in the pressurization tubes instead of titanium valves.  The improvement should prevent the very possibility of a repeat of the scenario that led to the crash in April.  Also not so long ago, in preparation for the Demo-2 mission, SpaceX successfully tested new parachutes for Crew Dragon.  A few weeks ago, Elon Musk shared a video with computer animation of the first manned flight of the Crew Dragon spacecraft to the ISS.  It is hardly worth saying how important for SpaceX and the entire world of cosmonautics is this launch, to which SpaceX has been going for eight long years.  Recall, Crew Dragon is being developed as part of NASA ’ s program to stimulate the development of private ships Commercial Crew Development to send American astronauts to the ISS and ensure independence in this matter from Russia.  After the closure of the Space Shuttle program in 2011, the only means of delivering crews to the International Space Station are the Russian Soyuz spacecraft.  It is noteworthy that on January 20, SpaceX plans to carry out the next launch of Falcon 9, sending into orbit another batch of 60 satellites as part of its own project of a global satellite Internet network of a new generation.  This year, SpaceX plans to begin providing communication services to its first customers, and full network deployment is scheduled for the mid-2020s.  In total, in 2020, SpaceX plans to make from 35 to 38 launches, of which at least 24 in the interests of the Starlink project.

Title: SpaceX successfully launches manned space capsule
Content: On Saturday, space exploration technology company SpaceX launched its first crew Dragon, a critical flight to prove to NASA the safety of astronauts in future flights.  The mission, called Demo-1, was launched on a Falcon 9 rocket from the Kennedy Air Center in California.  This space capsule does not carry a human, but a model of an astronaut called Ripley, wearing sensors to measure various indicators of the human body in the space capsule.  This is the first of two SpaceX test flights under NASA ’ s Commercial Crew Program. Demo-2 will be the first to fly with a human pilot, scheduled for July of this year.  According to NASA ’ s plan, SpaceX will be the first company to send astronauts into space since 2011.  NASA Administrator Jim Bridenstine later stated that the successful launch marked a new chapter in American excellence, bringing us once again closer to carrying American astronauts from American soil on American rockets.  Since the retirement of the Space Shuttle in 2011, the United States has been unable to use its own rockets to transport astronauts to space on its own. NASA is working with private companies to develop the future of human spaceflight.  Currently, SpaceX and NASA have a contract value of $2.6 billion, and Boeing is $4.2 billion.
