Title: A repeat of the nightmare of 2015. Europe is facing a new migration crisis
Content: https: / / ria.ru / 20210525 / migratsiya-1733716124.html A repeat of the nightmare of 2015.  Europe is facing a new migration crisis, a repeat of the nightmare of 2015.  Europe is waiting for a new migration crisis - RIA Novosti, 25.05.2021 A repeat of the nightmare of 2015.  Europe is once again on the brink of a migration crisis.  And this is not yet the summer, which traditionally accounts for the peak of the wave of illegal migration from countries...  RIA Novosti, 25.05.2021 2021-05-25T08: 00 2021-05-25T08: 00 2021-05-25T08: 02 migrants refugees europe authors / html / head / meta [@ name = 'og: title'] / @ content / html / head / meta [@ name = 'og: description'] / @ content https: / / cdn.com 24.img.ria.ru / images / 07e5 / 05 / 18 / 1733713287 _ 0: 153: 1920: 1233 _ 1920x0 _ 80 _ 0 _ 85ca65dc729db44d8073637ad5013c74.jpg Europe is again on the verge of a migration crisis.  And this is not yet the summer, which traditionally accounts for the peak of the wave of illegal migration from Asia and Africa.Now in the center of attention is Ceuta, a Spanish enclave in North Africa, where thousands of illegal refugees from Morocco rushed.  The refugee crisis in Ceuta and Melilla (another Spanish port in Africa) is largely the result of the artificial escalation of relations between Spain and Morocco.  According to many observers, Rabat decided to take revenge on Madrid for the assistance recently provided to the Polisario Front (which for many years has been fighting for the independence of Western Sahara from Morocco).  The revenge was the actual inaction of the border guards of this country, who turned a blind eye to the crowds of migrants breaking into Ceuta.  According to The Economist magazine, in this way King Mohammed VI of Morocco “made migration a weapon ” .But in fact, the sharp influx of refugees from Africa began not only in the Spanish enclaves.  Again, a series of flimsy ships illegally transporting Africans (mainly Libyans) from Tunisia to the Italian island of Lampedusa.  Last week, 1,200 people were transferred there during 12 hours of good weather alone.  And even despite the weather, accidents were recorded: 73 refugees from Bangladesh almost drowned trying to reach the cherished island.  How long it took, no one can say.  According to the Italian Interior Ministry, 4,290 migrants reached the country ’ s shores in the first three weeks of May.  While for the whole of May last year, their number was 1654 people.  The flow of illegal refugees is also increasing between the EU and Britain.  Since January, more than three thousand people have crossed the English Channel.  And over the same period last year, this figure was 1,400 refugees – more than double the growth.  Just the other day, the Belgian coast guard rescued a sinking ship on which 49 migrants, mostly Vietnamese, tried to cross the strait.  Based on the above facts and statistics, we can safely assume that the migration crisis will return to the European agenda in the foreseeable future.  However, the numbers are not as catastrophic as they were in 2015, when Europe was literally drowned by a flood of refugees.  And the increase compared to last year is easily explained by the fact that in 2020, many people in Asia and Africa gave up their intentions to go to pandemics in Europe.  In addition, the result of the shift of public attention from the problem of migration to the fight against the covid was a noticeable decrease in the ratings of a number of parties advocating strict measures to limit the influx of immigrants (in the Western media, these political organizations are usually indiscriminately called ultra-right, even despite the rather liberal economic program of many of them).  It is quite logical that now, with the rapid return of migration problems to the agenda, many publications have sounded the alarm in connection with the imminent growth of the popularity of these political forces.  Almost all analysts agree that the crisis around Ceuta, which has not descended from the front pages of the Spanish press for several days, will significantly strengthen the anti-Islamic party Vox (Voice).  Even before the current crisis, it actively dispersed the fears of the enclave residents in connection with the influx of poor Africans.  And in the end, it won the first place in the parliamentary elections of 2019, receiving more than 35 percent of the vote – and this is in a city where 40 percent of the population is Muslim.  It would be strange if the Vox party did not now take advantage of the crisis to increase its popularity in Ceuta.  For example, a local cell of the party is publicizing protests against the fact that African migrants entering the Spanish enclave receive coronavirus vaccinations, while Spanish citizens living there wait months for their turn.  This is confirmed by events in the regional parliament of Andalusia, where after the 2018 elections, for the first time in history, the People ’ s Party took the first place and was able to form a minority government.  Until last week, it relied solely on the informal support of Vox MPs.  However, on Thursday, they announced the termination of cooperation with the senior partner in connection with the fact that the authorities of the region agreed to accept 13 minor refugees who infiltrated Ceuta.  This could lead to the fall of the regional government and early elections.  That is why the People ’ s Party is forced to show more and more rigidity in the migration issue, causing panic in the European liberal media.Even more worrying in the mainstream is the electoral situation in Italy.  After the 2015 crisis, the League party, led by Matteo Salvini, has been the consistent leader of the polls there.  Having proved himself a tough fighter against illegal migration as the Minister of Internal Affairs, he increased the leadership of his party to record levels.  At the peak of popularity in the summer of 2019, the League ’ s figures were approaching 40 percent, which gave it hope even for the formation of its government.  Based on these calculations, Salvini provoked a government crisis in order to hold early elections, but was outplayed by opponents.  Since last year, there has been a drop in the ratings of this political force, whose supporters cannot forgive the support it expressed for the technocratic government of Mario Draghi.  Liberals can breathe freely.  But the fact is that the ratings of the League, which is still in the first place in the polls, are moving on opposite courses with the rapidly growing indicators of the even more right-wing and even more anti-migrant party “Brothers of Italy ”.  According to some polls, she already came in second place after the League, behind that couple of percent.  Three years ago, its ratings fluctuated around three to four percent, and now confidently approaching 20.  If elections were held now, these two forces, with the support of Silvio Berlusconi ’ s Forward Italy party, could well form a majority government.  They do not hide their ideological continuity from the far-right Italian social movement, which was created in 1946 by former supporters of Benito Mussolini.  This legacy is clearly indicated by the logo of the party, which includes the former symbol of ISD.The growth of the popularity of the "Brothers" will contribute to the charisma of the head of the party Georgia Meloni ("Sisters of Italy", as it was nicknamed by the press) - she last year surpassed in the approval ratings of the leader of the "League", becoming the second most popular politician in the country after the current prime minister.  There is no doubt that in the event of an aggravation of the migration crisis, the League and Brothers will be able to get additional votes to their already serious ratings.  Trends in the first months of the year show that the threat of the covid is no longer deterring refugees seeking to Europe.  And this means that the nightmare of 2015 may repeat itself — and the popularity of far-right, anti-migrant, anti-Islamic, Eurosceptic parties will again sharply rise. Title: UN: EU to Blame for Deaths of Migrants in Mediterranean Sea
Content: The United Nations has been implicated in the deaths of migrants in the Mediterranean because of its refusal to respond to calls for emergency relief, its refusal to meet humanitarian rescue efforts and its push to return them to Libya.  In its 37-page report, the UN said the number of migrant deaths this year on the sea route had so far reached 632.  The United Nations has described the incident as a “large-scale humanitarian tragedy. ”  Thousands of migrants and refugees, including from African countries, make long and risky voyages through Libya each year in hopes of getting to Europe and living a better life.  They often use small, inflatable boats to cross this dangerous path.  The report concluded that the lack of protection for migrants “is not a sad anomaly, but rather a consequence of the policies, decisions and actions of Libyan authorities, EU members, institutions and other actors.  The European Union has not only reduced the search and rescue operations of migrants in Mediterranean waters, but its governments have each hindered the rescue operations of humanitarian organizations with their own administrative and criminal proceedings.  Migrants told the UN Human Rights Office there were also efforts to "repatriate migrants at sea", which would return ships carrying migrants from international waters to Libya with the help of European helicopters.  The report is based on interviews with 80 migrants between January 2019 and December 2020.  According to them, some have faced interception operations by Libyan officials and their lives are in danger.  Some boats have been shot down, causing boats to capsize or forcing migrants to jump into the sea.  Most of the migrants returned to Libya face exploitation and ill-treatment.  Commenting on the report, UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Michelle Bachelet called for urgent reforms in the search and rescue policies and actions taken by Libya, the European Union and its member states to ensure that such policies and measures are complied with international law.  The real tragedy is that it is preventable to prevent the suffering and deaths of migrants on the current Mediterranean route.  The United Nations has called on European countries to use more effective and efficient mechanisms to address the wave of migrants and refugees.  The Guardian previously revealed that European countries used brutal methods to stop the passage of almost 40,000 refugees during the coronavirus epidemic, resulting in 2,000 deaths.

Aircraft is made according to two-fuselage scheme.  It has six Pratt & Whitney PW40 engines.  Also, the aircraft is equipped with a 28-wheel chassis that can withstand such loads, so it can simultaneously carry up to three Orbital ATK Pegasus XL missiles and put into orbit from an altitude of about nine thousand meters.  After commissioning, it will become a platform for launching small launch vehicles: it will raise them to a height of 9,100 meters above the ground - from there, the missiles will launch to low-Earth orbit on their own.  It is planned that the commissioning of the aircraft will take place no earlier than 2019.

passages.passage: Venture aerospace company Stratolaunch Systems said that the flight of the Scaled Composites Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft will take place this summer.  This was announced at the scientific conference of the 34th Space Symposium in Colorado Springs.  However, according to experts, it is possible that the expected date may be moved to a later date.  This is due to the complexity of the design and the use of fundamentally new design solutions.  Now behind the plane — a number of successfully passed ground tests.  In February of this year, it became known that the Scaled Composites Stratolaunch Model 351 as part of the steering tests reached a speed of 46 mph (74 km / h).  The test took place in Mojave, California.  The first taxiing tests of the aircraft performed even earlier, and rolled it out on May 31 last year.  At the same time, the first high-quality photos of the almost completed winged car appeared.  It is worth noting that, although small aircraft are able to rise into the air at relatively low speeds, for the take-off of such a large machine will require a much greater speed.  At the same time, engineers did everything possible to facilitate the aircraft.  The company Scaled Composites used the most advanced composite materials in the construction.  The aircraft is made according to a very original two-fuselage scheme.  It has six Pratt & Whitney PW4056 twin-circuit turbojet engines.  The car has the largest wingspan in history.  It can also be considered the largest aircraft.  Immediately behind the Scaled Composites Stratolaunch Model 351 is the Soviet transport aircraft An-225 ("Mriya"), significantly inferior to the "American" in wing span.  The third place is occupied by Airbus A340-600.  The largest production aircraft in the world and the largest passenger capacity recognized the famous Airbus A380.  Recall that the aerospace system "air launch" Stratolaunch presented back in 2011.  It is designed to put 6.12 tons of payload into low Earth orbit.  The complex includes three main components: a giant aircraft, a multi-stage rocket and a system that allows you to combine these two segments.

passages.passage: Video of Stratolaunch Systems' world's first two-fuselage aircraft flying from an airport near Los Angeles has been posted on social media.  NASA physicist Thomas Sorbochen called the flight a historic event for the team of designers.  He said, “We ’ re going to send it to space and beyond. ”  Stratolaunch Systems is an American aerospace company created to design aeronautical and astronautical systems that can carry cargo into space with the help of aircraft.  The wingspan of the world ’ s largest aircraft is 117 meters.  The aircraft is equipped with six Boeing 747 engines.  The company plans to launch its first satellite in 2020 with the help of the aircraft.

passages.title: The second largest flight in the world.
passages.passage: Two years after the first flight, the world ’ s largest plane has taken to the skies for another flight.  The Stratolaunch aircraft conducted a second test flight and a series of manoeuvres over Mojave Air and Space Station yesterday, and everything went as planned.  The plane made its second test flight on Thursday morning (April 29).  Stratolaunch was founded in 2011 by Paul Allen.  The first flight of the aircraft took place in April 2013.  The first flight lasted two and a half hours, during which it flew at 17,000 feet in the Mojave Desert, with a top speed of 189 miles per hour (304 km / h).  The aircraft, known as the "Roc", was originally designed as an airborne orbital launch system to carry missiles and satellites at altitude and then launch them into near-Earth orbit, but when the company was sold to its current owners in October 2019, there were changes to its purpose and the aircraft will now serve as a mobile launch pad for supersonic vehicles.  During Thursday ’ s test flight, Roc reached a maximum altitude of 14,000 feet (4,267 m) and a top speed of 199 mph (320 km / h).  Stratolaunch made the flight using its six 747s and then conducted a series of test maneuvers for its second successful flight.  The plane remained at altitude for 3 hours and 14 minutes.  End of message.

passages.title: The late Alan Space Dream Broken sister takes over the company ’ s “world ’ s largest aircraft ”
passages.passage: Microsoft co-founder Paul Allen, who died on October 15, 2018, said in 2011 that he had a dream of space. Although myopia does not allow him to be a pilot, he has never forgotten his dream of exploring space.  However, Stratolaunch Systems, the aircraft manufacturer he founded in the past, is facing a crisis of termination and may never see their “world ’ s largest aircraft ” again in the future.  Alan was very active in developing the world ’ s largest aircraft.  Stratolaunch, the world ’ s largest aircraft with the longest wingspan, successfully flew in California in mid-April, aiming to complete the idea of carrying a medium-sized rocket on the aircraft and launching it from the air into outer space by 2022, Reuters reported.  But a number of insiders recently revealed that parent company Vulcan Inc. is planning to sell Stratolaunch, ending its dream of entering space.  The world ’ s largest aircraft flew successfully in California on April 13.  (Photo / Reuters) Since Allen died last year, Stratolaunch ’ s operations have gradually stopped, and employees have shrunk from 77 to 21, and they have moved to other aerospace companies.  Allen ’ s sister, Jody Allen, is the chairman of Stratolaunch ’ s parent company, Vulcan Inc., and the executor of Allen ’ s estate. She was planning to take over Stratolaunch last year, and later flew the world ’ s largest aircraft in memory of her brother.  ★ Images are copyrighted photos, used by Reuters for the exclusive use of "ETtoday News Cloud", any website, newspaper, TV station without the permission of Reuters, may not be reproduced in part or in whole!

passages.passage: The second test flight of the world ’ s largest aircraft, the Roc, was successful.  (Photo / Reuters) - US aerospace company Stratolaunch Systems announced that the world's largest aircraft "Roc" has completed its second test flight on April 29, US Eastern Time, flying at an altitude of 14,000 feet (about 4.267 km) and a top speed of 320 km / h, the second attempt after a successful test flight two years ago.  The stratospheric emission system said that it was satisfied with the results of this test.  The Big Mac “Roc ” completed its second test flight at the Mojave Air and Space Port in California at 10: 30 am EST on April 29, 2019. The flight time was longer than the first test flight in 2019, with a total flight time of 3 hours and 14 minutes and a flight altitude of 14,000 feet (about 4.267 kilometers) and a maximum speed of 320 kilometers per hour.  In this regard, the stratospheric emission system said that it is satisfied with the results of this test.  ▲ Roc has a maximum speed of 320 kilometers per hour. (Photo / Reuters) Roc has two independent bodies, six engines, a wingspan of 117 meters, and was originally designed for a “small satellite launch platform ” with the goal of launching a rocket at about 10 kilometers to directly put a satellite into space orbit.  Currently performing various flight test maneuvers.  pic.twitter.com / u9uMWzfrEK — Stratolaunch (@ Stratolaunch) April 29, 2021 It is understood that the Stratolaunch launch system is currently developing a reusable "Talon-A" ultra-sonic flight research device, "Talon-A" a rocket-powered jet spacecraft, 28 feet long (about 8.5 meters), with a top speed of 6 Mach, far more than 5 times the speed of sound, can provide about 1 minute of ultra-high speed flight.  The development assembly is expected to be completed in 2022 and the first flight test will be conducted in 2023.

passages.title: The world ’ s largest aircraft is finally ready for testing.
passages.passage: Back in August 2015, Stratolaunch Systems, which was invested by Microsoft co-founder Paul Allen, announced that it would fly the world ’ s largest aircraft, Stratolaunch, in 2016.  But the final plan did not come to fruition, and it is only today that the situation has finally made new progress.  Earlier, Allen posted a photo of the plane leaving the hangar on Twitter, and wrote below that the move was for “fuel testing. ” The Stratolaunch, the largest all-combined aircraft in history, could almost be seen in length as a combination of two Boeing 747s propelled by six 747 engines with a payload of nearly 230 tons.  The original intention of building such an aircraft was to launch rockets in the air, so that fuel would be saved and the launch would not be affected by the weather.  Previously, Stratolaunch Systems had expressed the hope that Stratolaunch will be officially put into use by 2020, and although the process has changed somewhat, it should be hopeful to achieve the original goal.

passages.title: World's Largest Aircraft Gets Ground Test at 74 km / h
passages.passage: Feb 27, 2018 14: 03 China Times News Yang Yulan has a wingspan of more than 117 meters, and the world ’ s largest aircraft with six engines is rapidly flying headfirst.  Recently, it has been seen moving rapidly at the Mojave Air and Space Port.  According to "The Drive" network reported on the 26th, now Stratolaunch Systems main sponsor Paul Allen took advantage of it before the first flight, released a wonderful picture of the roc rapid ground test.  Allen tweeted that it can reach a top speed of 46 miles per hour (74 km / h), which is quite fast for a big baby with a net weight of 226,800 kg, a maximum fuel load of 113,400 kg and an external weight of 250,000 kg.  Because in recent months, the Pentagon has sought to increase the flexibility and agility of its space capabilities, and has even been actively considering space as the next battleground, the tools to launch smaller satellites into orbit quickly and cheaply appear to be full of business opportunities.  (Stratolaunch Systems) To achieve this goal, the US Air Force ’ s 2019 budget for space “small launches ” lists a five-year plan with a budget of nearly US $200 million (nearly NT $6 billion), which will fund companies that can provide related services in the future.  U.S. Air Force Secretary Heather Wilson said the goal of the project is to develop a variety of launch capabilities to ensure access to space.  The world's largest aircraft, nicknamed Dapeng, can carry a 110-ton rocket from the ground to 35,000 feet (nearly 11,000 meters) in the stratosphere below the wings and in the middle of the fuselage, and then let the rocket ignite, launch, escape from the atmosphere, and then send satellites into low-Earth orbit.  Air-launched rockets have advantages and disadvantages compared to ground-launched rockets.  The advantage is that the air-launched rocket can avoid the dense atmosphere on the surface, greatly reducing the thrust / lift required for the rocket to enter the orbit, thus reducing the cost.  Overall, this launch method can quickly launch a launch object into space at a lower cost, without the need for complex launch site equipment.  In addition, the research of air-launched rocket technology has great military value.  The disadvantage of air-launched rockets is that during take-off, liftoff and flight, the rocket may be accidentally damaged, which increases the uncertainty of the launch.  (China Times Newsletter)

passages.title: The world ’ s largest aircraft can launch three rockets for the first time.
passages.passage: Stratolaunch Systems created the world ’ s largest aircraft and debuted on May 31 at the Mojave Space Station in California. (Photo / Stratolaunch Systems) The airborne giant has 28 wheels.  Stratolaunch Systems (Stratolaunch Systems), founded by Microsoft co-founder Paul Allen, announced on May 31 that the world ’ s largest aircraft will be launched for the first time at the Mojave Air and Space Port in California.  According to SPACENEWS and CNN, the huge object has a double body, a wingspan of more than 117 meters, a net weight of 226,800 kg, a maximum fuel load of 113,400 kg, and an external weight of 250,000 kg.  It has 28 wheels in addition to six engines used in the Boeing 747.  The company was originally set up in late 2011 to launch the mid-size SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, but as the two companies parted ways a year later, Stratolaunch then signed a contract with Orbital Sciences Corp, now known as Orbital ATK, to launch the mid-size rocket.  However, due to the increasing need to launch small satellites, Stratolaunch is now focusing on providing related services.  Allen ’ s newly unveiled baby can launch up to three Pegasus XL small rockets with just one flight.  Stratosphere Launch Systems said in a statement that since this is the world ’ s first new aircraft, it is expected that the giant will fly as early as 2019 after thorough testing for the safety of the pilot and crew.  It will begin with a series of ground tests, including refueling tests, with six tanks on board. The refueling mechanism will be tested separately and whether oil leaks will occur.  Stratolaunch is working on technology to reduce launch costs, and its CEO, Jean Floyd, believes they have shown results.  He pointed out that Allen ’ s motivation for investing is not to make big money, but to change the human environment.  Stratolaunch ’ s world ’ s largest aircraft can launch three small rockets at a time. (Photo / Stratolaunch Systems) The world ’ s largest aircraft, nicknamed Roc, can carry a rocket weighing up to 110 tons to an altitude of nearly 11,000 meters in the stratosphere to launch the rocket. (Photo / Stratolaunch Systems) The aircraft can carry a 110-ton rocket from the ground to 35,000 feet (nearly 11,000 meters) in the stratosphere, and then fire the rocket, launch it out of the atmosphere, and then send satellites into low Earth orbit.  Air-launched rockets have advantages and disadvantages compared to ground-launched rockets.  The advantage is that the air-launched rocket can avoid the dense atmosphere on the surface, greatly reducing the thrust / lift required for the rocket to enter the orbit, thus reducing the cost.  Overall, this launch method can quickly launch a launch object into space at a lower cost, without the need for complex launch site equipment.  In addition, the research of air-launched rocket technology has great military value.  The disadvantage of air-launched rockets is that during take-off, liftoff and flight, the rocket may be accidentally damaged, which increases the uncertainty of the launch.  SpaceX founder Elon Musk believes that the advantages of an air-launched rocket are not enough to make up for its shortcomings. “From SpaceX ’ s point of view, to launch a rocket with a huge aircraft, or to increase the first stage capacity of the rocket by 5%? I will choose the latter. ”

passages.title: Pandora ’ s Box – In the United States for the first time rolled out of the hangar the largest aircraft in the world (PHOTOS, VIDEO)
passages.passage: May 31, 2017 in Mojave (California) took place the roll-out of the almost completed construction of the Stratolaunch Model 351 carrier aircraft (also sometimes referred to as "Roc", in fact, the official name has not yet been assigned) of the aerospace system "air launch" Stratolaunch, created by the American company Stratolaunch Systems (as part of Vulcan Aerospace Corporation). The BMPD blog.  Rolling out of the carrier aircraft Stratolaunch Model 351 aerospace system "air start" Stratolaunch American company Stratolaunch Systems.  Mojave (California), 31.05.2017 (c) Stratolaunch Systems The built twin-body Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft is the largest aircraft in history, having a wingspan of 117 m and a length of 73 m. The maximum take-off weight should be 590 tons, with a suspended payload weight of 230 tons.  Thus, the Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft in wingspan exceeds the former largest aircraft in the world, the Soviet An-225 "Mriya" (which has a wingspan of 88.4 m), although the An-225 retains an advantage in length (84 m) and maximum take-off weight (640 tons).  The Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft is equipped with six twin-circuit Pratt & Whitney PW4056 turbojet engines with a thrust of 25 tons, removed from two decommissioned Boeing 747-400 aircraft.  The landing gear of the aircraft is 28-wheel, take-off distance with full load should be calculated to be 3800 m. The maximum range of the aircraft with full load will not exceed 3700 km.  The aircraft is designed to be used as a carrier for the aerospace system Stratolaunch, created by the American company Stratolaunch Systems, founded by co-founder Microsot Paul Allen and the famous aircraft designer Bert Rutan (who acted as the actual chief designer of the aircraft) (since 2015 Stratolaunch Systems is a subsidiary of the corporation created by the same Paul Allen Vulcan Aerospace).  The aircraft is designed to launch space launch vehicles using the "air launch" method, which will be carried out from an altitude of approximately 10,500 m. The launch vehicle should be suspended under the central part of the wing between the fuselages.  In the course of design and construction, the SpaceX Falcon 9 Air and Orbital ATK Pegasus II launch vehicles were successively replaced as payload options, and now only the long-known Orbital ATK Pegasus XL light launch vehicle used for “air launches ” from“ conventional ” aircraft in the United States since 1990 is considered as such (starting mass of 23.2 tons, payload mass load of 443 kg), and for which there was no need to create such a giant carrier - although the possibility of carrying and launching from it in one flight up to three Pegasus XL launch vehicles is claimed.  In light of this, the outlook for Stratolaunch is still uncertain.  In 2014, the notorious Sierra Nevada Corporation announced the development of a smaller version of the project of its lightweight manned shuttle Dream Chaser (previously rejected by NASA), which was to be launched using an unnamed launch vehicle developed by the Orbital ATK.  However, there is no information about the development of this project in relation to Stratolaunch.  During the launch vehicle roll-out ceremony on May 31, Stratolauch Systems CEO Joan Floyd said that the company would "actively explore a wide range of launch vehicles, allowing us to provide more flexibility for customers."  Rolling out of the carrier aircraft Stratolaunch Model 351 aerospace system "air start" Stratolaunch American company Stratolaunch Systems.  The Stratolaunch Model 351 was designed and built under the contract of Stratolaunch Systems by Scaled Composites, founded by Bert Rutan and now owned by Northrop Grumman Corporation.  The project was announced in December 2011.  The construction of the aircraft was carried out in a specially built for this purpose in 2012 in Mojave giant hangar.  The scheme of the intended use of the aircraft carrier Stratolaunch Model 351 of the aerospace system "air launch" Stratolaunch American company Stratolaunch Systems (c) Stratolaunch Systems The program is lagging behind in terms of about two years.  Currently, the beginning of flight tests of the carrier aircraft is scheduled for the end of 2017, and the first demonstration space launch from it - in 2019.  The start of commercial launches will be possible in this case from 2020. The launch vehicle should be suspended under the central part of the wing between the fuselages.  In the course of design and construction, the SpaceX Falcon 9 Air and Orbital ATK Pegasus II launch vehicles were successively replaced as payload options, and now only the long-known Orbital ATK Pegasus XL light launch vehicle used for “air launches ” from“ conventional ” aircraft in the United States since 1990 is considered as such (starting mass of 23.2 tons, payload mass load of 443 kg), and for which there was no need to create such a giant carrier - although the possibility of carrying and launching from it in one flight up to three Pegasus XL launch vehicles is claimed. Title: The world ’ s largest aircraft can launch three rockets for the first time.
Content: Stratolaunch Systems created the world ’ s largest aircraft and debuted on May 31 at the Mojave Space Station in California. (Photo / Stratolaunch Systems) The airborne giant has 28 wheels.  Stratolaunch Systems (Stratolaunch Systems), founded by Microsoft co-founder Paul Allen, announced on May 31 that the world ’ s largest aircraft will be launched for the first time at the Mojave Air and Space Port in California.  According to SPACENEWS and CNN, the huge object has a double body, a wingspan of more than 117 meters, a net weight of 226,800 kg, a maximum fuel load of 113,400 kg, and an external weight of 250,000 kg.  It has 28 wheels in addition to six engines used in the Boeing 747.  The company was originally set up in late 2011 to launch the mid-size SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, but as the two companies parted ways a year later, Stratolaunch then signed a contract with Orbital Sciences Corp, now known as Orbital ATK, to launch the mid-size rocket.  However, due to the increasing need to launch small satellites, Stratolaunch is now focusing on providing related services.  Allen ’ s newly unveiled baby can launch up to three Pegasus XL small rockets with just one flight.  Stratosphere Launch Systems said in a statement that since this is the world ’ s first new aircraft, it is expected that the giant will fly as early as 2019 after thorough testing for the safety of the pilot and crew.  It will begin with a series of ground tests, including refueling tests, with six tanks on board. The refueling mechanism will be tested separately and whether oil leaks will occur.  Stratolaunch is working on technology to reduce launch costs, and its CEO, Jean Floyd, believes they have shown results.  He pointed out that Allen ’ s motivation for investing is not to make big money, but to change the human environment.  Stratolaunch ’ s world ’ s largest aircraft can launch three small rockets at a time. (Photo / Stratolaunch Systems) The world ’ s largest aircraft, nicknamed Roc, can carry a rocket weighing up to 110 tons to an altitude of nearly 11,000 meters in the stratosphere to launch the rocket. (Photo / Stratolaunch Systems) The aircraft can carry a 110-ton rocket from the ground to 35,000 feet (nearly 11,000 meters) in the stratosphere, and then fire the rocket, launch it out of the atmosphere, and then send satellites into low Earth orbit.  Air-launched rockets have advantages and disadvantages compared to ground-launched rockets.  The advantage is that the air-launched rocket can avoid the dense atmosphere on the surface, greatly reducing the thrust / lift required for the rocket to enter the orbit, thus reducing the cost.  Overall, this launch method can quickly launch a launch object into space at a lower cost, without the need for complex launch site equipment.  In addition, the research of air-launched rocket technology has great military value.  The disadvantage of air-launched rockets is that during take-off, liftoff and flight, the rocket may be accidentally damaged, which increases the uncertainty of the launch.  SpaceX founder Elon Musk believes that the advantages of an air-launched rocket are not enough to make up for its shortcomings. “From SpaceX ’ s point of view, to launch a rocket with a huge aircraft, or to increase the first stage capacity of the rocket by 5%? I will choose the latter. ”

Title: Pandora ’ s Box – In the United States for the first time rolled out of the hangar the largest aircraft in the world (PHOTOS, VIDEO)
Content: May 31, 2017 in Mojave (California) took place the roll-out of the almost completed construction of the Stratolaunch Model 351 carrier aircraft (also sometimes referred to as "Roc", in fact, the official name has not yet been assigned) of the aerospace system "air launch" Stratolaunch, created by the American company Stratolaunch Systems (as part of Vulcan Aerospace Corporation). The BMPD blog.  Rolling out of the carrier aircraft Stratolaunch Model 351 aerospace system "air start" Stratolaunch American company Stratolaunch Systems.  Mojave (California), 31.05.2017 (c) Stratolaunch Systems The built twin-body Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft is the largest aircraft in history, having a wingspan of 117 m and a length of 73 m. The maximum take-off weight should be 590 tons, with a suspended payload weight of 230 tons.  Thus, the Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft in wingspan exceeds the former largest aircraft in the world, the Soviet An-225 "Mriya" (which has a wingspan of 88.4 m), although the An-225 retains an advantage in length (84 m) and maximum take-off weight (640 tons).  The Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft is equipped with six twin-circuit Pratt & Whitney PW4056 turbojet engines with a thrust of 25 tons, removed from two decommissioned Boeing 747-400 aircraft.  The landing gear of the aircraft is 28-wheel, take-off distance with full load should be calculated to be 3800 m. The maximum range of the aircraft with full load will not exceed 3700 km.  The aircraft is designed to be used as a carrier for the aerospace system Stratolaunch, created by the American company Stratolaunch Systems, founded by co-founder Microsot Paul Allen and the famous aircraft designer Bert Rutan (who acted as the actual chief designer of the aircraft) (since 2015 Stratolaunch Systems is a subsidiary of the corporation created by the same Paul Allen Vulcan Aerospace).  The aircraft is designed to launch space launch vehicles using the "air launch" method, which will be carried out from an altitude of approximately 10,500 m. The launch vehicle should be suspended under the central part of the wing between the fuselages.  In the course of design and construction, the SpaceX Falcon 9 Air and Orbital ATK Pegasus II launch vehicles were successively replaced as payload options, and now only the long-known Orbital ATK Pegasus XL light launch vehicle used for “air launches ” from“ conventional ” aircraft in the United States since 1990 is considered as such (starting mass of 23.2 tons, payload mass load of 443 kg), and for which there was no need to create such a giant carrier - although the possibility of carrying and launching from it in one flight up to three Pegasus XL launch vehicles is claimed.  In light of this, the outlook for Stratolaunch is still uncertain.  In 2014, the notorious Sierra Nevada Corporation announced the development of a smaller version of the project of its lightweight manned shuttle Dream Chaser (previously rejected by NASA), which was to be launched using an unnamed launch vehicle developed by the Orbital ATK.  However, there is no information about the development of this project in relation to Stratolaunch.  During the launch vehicle roll-out ceremony on May 31, Stratolauch Systems CEO Joan Floyd said that the company would "actively explore a wide range of launch vehicles, allowing us to provide more flexibility for customers."  Rolling out of the carrier aircraft Stratolaunch Model 351 aerospace system "air start" Stratolaunch American company Stratolaunch Systems.  The Stratolaunch Model 351 was designed and built under the contract of Stratolaunch Systems by Scaled Composites, founded by Bert Rutan and now owned by Northrop Grumman Corporation.  The project was announced in December 2011.  The construction of the aircraft was carried out in a specially built for this purpose in 2012 in Mojave giant hangar.  The scheme of the intended use of the aircraft carrier Stratolaunch Model 351 of the aerospace system "air launch" Stratolaunch American company Stratolaunch Systems (c) Stratolaunch Systems The program is lagging behind in terms of about two years.  Currently, the beginning of flight tests of the carrier aircraft is scheduled for the end of 2017, and the first demonstration space launch from it - in 2019.  The start of commercial launches will be possible in this case from 2020. passages.title: Mass blockage at the cycling race "Tour de France" because of the antics of the cheerleader: the girl hit the racers with a poster and ran away
passages.passage: The girl showed the camera a poster with a joke inscription, knocked down the racers on the asphalt and fled from the scene.  45 km before the end of the first stage of the legendary cycling race "Tour de France" there was a massive blockage, as a result of which more than two dozen athletes were injured.  Almost half of the peloton fell, including the main favorites.  The culprit of the accident was a cheerleader who put up a poster with a joke inscription right in front of the riders.  Now she is wanted by the police, who asked witnesses for help through social networks.  The organizers of the race promised her legal proceedings.  "Allez Opi-Omi" The cheerleader intervened in the battle of the strongest riders of the world at the most famous stage race in history at the first stage from Brest to Landerno.  About 45 km before the finish, the girl in blue jeans and a bright yellow jacket jumped from the side of the road and put on camera in front of the athletes a poster with the inscription “Allez Opi-Omi ” (a joke and caressing appeal to grandparents in German, something like“ Go, old men ”).  Driving on the right side of the rider of the team “Jumbo Wisma ” German Tony Martin had no chance to dodge the collision with the poster and fell, which led to a major blockage.  Not escaped this and the main favorites: Slovenes Tadej Pogacar and Primož Roglic.  But they at least cost bruises and abrasions, but Spaniard Mark Soler of “Movistar ” broke the radial bones on both hands.  By some miracle, he reached the finish line, but he will not be able to continue the race.  Like the German Jascha Sutterlin.  Those who continued the Tour de France lost a lot of time.  “We had everything under control, I led the guys on the right side of the road, but crashed into a fan poster.  It all happened very quickly, all of a sudden, almost everyone was on the ground.  Many viewers behave respectfully, but in this case this was not the case, unfortunately.  I hope that there will be no consequences for the health of all the guys who fell into the rubble, ” said Tony Martin.  A year behind bars and a 15,000 euro fine The cheerleader, who became the culprit of the accident, quickly disappeared.  The Gendarmerie Landerno put her on the wanted list and asked for help from witnesses, posting a post on social media.  However, the comments are more negative towards the police than the desire to help find a negligent fan.  The organizers of the Tour de France have already promised that the culprit of the collision is awaiting trial.  “We must not allow a small number of hooligans to spoil the sporting event for participants and fans, ” said Pierre-Yves Tuo, deputy director of the race.  What threatens the offender?  While injured in the accident riders did not submit a statement to the police – a fine of 1500 euros.  But if Soler and Sutterlin write such a statement, the case will be reclassified.  Now the fan is accused that failure to comply with the required security measures led to harm to health.  In the case of a statement from the riders unknown until the violator faces a fine ten times more and up to a year in prison.  The organizers appealed to all fans with a request to observe security measures and even released a special video reminding how dangerous such clashes can be.  There are a lot of fans in the current Tour de France.  And almost no one follows the antiquated rules.  The organizers are ready to turn a blind eye to this, but when the physical safety of athletes is threatened, it is quite another matter.  The athletes themselves also urged fans to be more restrained in the display of emotions, although clashes with fans in cycling are quite regular.  But now it has crossed all boundaries.  “I hope Opi-Omi are proud of you, ” Belgian cyclist Jasper Stuyven wrote on Twitter.  It is wonderful to see that there are so many fans who love our sport and support us.  But please stay on the side of the road, not on the road! ”  The participants of the Tour de France quite cope with the organization of force majeure and without the participation of fans.  At the same first stage, about 8 km before the finish line, Briton Chris Froome forked to the side and organized another blockage, himself and being the main victim.  But serious injuries to athletes were avoided.  The leader in the overall stage race after two stages is the Dutchman Mathieu van der Poole from the Alpesin-Phoenix team.  Russian riders do not participate in the current Tour de France.

The 197.8-kilometer race suffered two serious car accidents, one of which was even more incredible – a selfish spectator who only wanted to “grab a picture ” and finally led to a rare large-scale car speculation.  Where did the driver get hurt, the rally gets angry, and the perpetrator who was derided as “you ’ re the dumbest today ” went?  The accident occurred 45 kilometers away from the finish, a woman wearing a bright yellow coat and holding up sunglasses stood beside the track with a card written on the cheering words, apparently facing the live camera, when her position and the cards in her hands were clearly too close to the track.  Before long, the main train group arrived, and the German driver in the front position, Tony Martin, hit the card and fell to the ground, becoming the beginning of a series of chaos.  The selfishness of the audience caused a major accident in France (click to enlarge): + 2 + 2 + 2 The selfishness of the woman in yellow not only caused two hot spots for the championship, including Italian championship champion Sonny Colbrelli and Dutch driver Wout van Aert to get involved in the accident, losing a lot of time, but also caused nine drivers to injure, including German driver Jasha. Suetterlin had to retire and was unable to compete in the second leg.  Reported that the audience was also injured in the accident.  In addition to this large-scale scramble, there was another accident 8 kilometers from the end, due to the accident on the high-speed section, up to 12 people were injured, the injury is also serious, the famous Chris Froome (Chris Froome) will withdraw, Swiss driver Marc Hirschi also suffered a serious shoulder injury, his UAE team mate, last Tour de France champion Tadej Pogacs ar) Even though he finished sixth, he still looked sad: “Today was not good at all, there were a lot of accidents, and my teammates were not in very good condition. ”  + 3 + 3 + 3 According to Reuters, the yellow woman who caused the car to be fried immediately fled and disappeared. Pierre-Yves Thouault, the deputy director of the Tour de France, will go to the end: “We will prosecute this woman who has behaved badly, and only by doing so can we deter that little bad person. ”  In the unexpected first stop, French driver Julian Alaphilippe of the Deceuninck-Quick-Step team won the championship in yellow. Title: A fan with a poster provoked a mass accident at the Tour de France
Content: At the first stage of the multi-day cycling race "Tour de France" on the stretch from Brest to Landerno, there was a mass fall of participants.  The cause of the accident was a cheerleader who accidentally touched one of the athletes with a poster.  According to Cyclingnews, a total of 21 cyclists were injured.  It is reported that one of the spectators held the poster in his hands in such a way that it was visible on the camera, but did not notice that it interferes with the participants of the competition.  German Tony Martin crashed into the poster, and several other athletes fell behind him.  Especially seriously affected three athletes who had to leave the distance.  Spaniard Mark Soler was able to finish with fractures of both hands, according to the website of his team Movistar. Title: Accident in Tour de France: Police pursue 'careless woman'
Content: An accident in the Tour de France; police in pursuit of the 'reckless woman' 46 minutes ago Image source Gendarmerie du finistere Image caption Police are searching for a woman who caused a bicycle accident French police are searching for a woman whose carelessness made headlines during the Tour de France.  The spectator entered the path of the cyclists with a placard in his hand, and as a result, many athletes crashed and fell to the ground in the first round.  On Saturday, she leaned into the road in the speed section of the race in Brittany, France, holding a placard.  The first cyclist he encountered was German Tony Martin, followed by a significant number of athletes.  Police say they have filed a criminal case for the incident.  According to police, the charge is "deliberate violation of safety regulations and causing injuries that could prevent someone from working for up to three months."  The image of the incident has been widely circulated on social media.  A woman in a yellow coat with a sign in German that reads “Grandma and Grandpa. ”  The woman stands with her back to the group of cyclists and does not notice that they are approaching.  One of the injured cyclists was forced to retire from the Tour de France, and eight other cyclists were suspended by the official doctor.  Police said the woman fled the scene after the incident.  Police have asked witnesses to give their information to officers.  The vice president of the Tour de France also called for legal action against the woman, saying: “We will sue her for her very bad behavior.  We do this so that a small group of people can ’ t ruin a show that ’ s for everyone. ”  France has recently eased some of the restrictions imposed by the coronavirus outbreak, with a sizable population making its way to cyclists to watch races.  The Tour de France is an annual cycling race for men.  It is considered to be the most prestigious bicycle road race in the world.  France hosts the tournament, but sometimes competitions are held in the surrounding countries.

Title: Mass blockage at the cycling race "Tour de France" because of the antics of the cheerleader: the girl hit the racers with a poster and ran away
Content: The girl showed the camera a poster with a joke inscription, knocked down the racers on the asphalt and fled from the scene.  45 km before the end of the first stage of the legendary cycling race "Tour de France" there was a massive blockage, as a result of which more than two dozen athletes were injured.  Almost half of the peloton fell, including the main favorites.  The culprit of the accident was a cheerleader who put up a poster with a joke inscription right in front of the riders.  Now she is wanted by the police, who asked witnesses for help through social networks.  The organizers of the race promised her legal proceedings.  "Allez Opi-Omi" The cheerleader intervened in the battle of the strongest riders of the world at the most famous stage race in history at the first stage from Brest to Landerno.  About 45 km before the finish, the girl in blue jeans and a bright yellow jacket jumped from the side of the road and put on camera in front of the athletes a poster with the inscription “Allez Opi-Omi ” (a joke and caressing appeal to grandparents in German, something like“ Go, old men ”).  Driving on the right side of the rider of the team “Jumbo Wisma ” German Tony Martin had no chance to dodge the collision with the poster and fell, which led to a major blockage.  Not escaped this and the main favorites: Slovenes Tadej Pogacar and Primož Roglic.  But they at least cost bruises and abrasions, but Spaniard Mark Soler of “Movistar ” broke the radial bones on both hands.  By some miracle, he reached the finish line, but he will not be able to continue the race.  Like the German Jascha Sutterlin.  Those who continued the Tour de France lost a lot of time.  “We had everything under control, I led the guys on the right side of the road, but crashed into a fan poster.  It all happened very quickly, all of a sudden, almost everyone was on the ground.  Many viewers behave respectfully, but in this case this was not the case, unfortunately.  I hope that there will be no consequences for the health of all the guys who fell into the rubble, ” said Tony Martin.  A year behind bars and a 15,000 euro fine The cheerleader, who became the culprit of the accident, quickly disappeared.  The Gendarmerie Landerno put her on the wanted list and asked for help from witnesses, posting a post on social media.  However, the comments are more negative towards the police than the desire to help find a negligent fan.  The organizers of the Tour de France have already promised that the culprit of the collision is awaiting trial.  “We must not allow a small number of hooligans to spoil the sporting event for participants and fans, ” said Pierre-Yves Tuo, deputy director of the race.  What threatens the offender?  While injured in the accident riders did not submit a statement to the police – a fine of 1500 euros.  But if Soler and Sutterlin write such a statement, the case will be reclassified.  Now the fan is accused that failure to comply with the required security measures led to harm to health.  In the case of a statement from the riders unknown until the violator faces a fine ten times more and up to a year in prison.  The organizers appealed to all fans with a request to observe security measures and even released a special video reminding how dangerous such clashes can be.  There are a lot of fans in the current Tour de France.  And almost no one follows the antiquated rules.  The organizers are ready to turn a blind eye to this, but when the physical safety of athletes is threatened, it is quite another matter.  The athletes themselves also urged fans to be more restrained in the display of emotions, although clashes with fans in cycling are quite regular.  But now it has crossed all boundaries.  “I hope Opi-Omi are proud of you, ” Belgian cyclist Jasper Stuyven wrote on Twitter.  It is wonderful to see that there are so many fans who love our sport and support us.  But please stay on the side of the road, not on the road! ”  The participants of the Tour de France quite cope with the organization of force majeure and without the participation of fans.  At the same first stage, about 8 km before the finish line, Briton Chris Froome forked to the side and organized another blockage, himself and being the main victim.  But serious injuries to athletes were avoided.  The leader in the overall stage race after two stages is the Dutchman Mathieu van der Poole from the Alpesin-Phoenix team.  Russian riders do not participate in the current Tour de France.

Title: Police are looking for the woman who caused the collision of cyclists during the Tour de France 2021
Content: The woman held a cardboard poster and stood very close to the roadway.  Soon there was a column of cyclists, but the woman, apparently, did not notice.  German cyclist Tony Martin crashed into a poster, causing him to lose his balance and fall.  This created a domino effect, and several cyclists collided with each other, creating a rather serious collision.  As a result, several cyclists were injured, 21 of which required medical attention, and one, because of the injuries, had to be removed from the race.  French police say an investigation will be carried out and the woman is being actively sought.  Police also conducted interviews with eyewitnesses to find out where the woman might have gone.  The organizers of the event also said that the woman will be charged.  "We will bring charges against this woman so that the rest of the small population that acts so irresponsibly does not spoil the viewing and the competition for others," Tour de France spokesman Pierre Yves told AFP.

title: SpaceX Crew Dragon DM-2

passages.title: SpaceX successfully launches manned space capsule
passages.passage: On Saturday, space exploration technology company SpaceX launched its first crew Dragon, a critical flight to prove to NASA the safety of astronauts in future flights.  The mission, called Demo-1, was launched on a Falcon 9 rocket from the Kennedy Air Center in California.  This space capsule does not carry a human, but a model of an astronaut called Ripley, wearing sensors to measure various indicators of the human body in the space capsule.  This is the first of two SpaceX test flights under NASA ’ s Commercial Crew Program. Demo-2 will be the first to fly with a human pilot, scheduled for July of this year.  According to NASA ’ s plan, SpaceX will be the first company to send astronauts into space since 2011.  NASA Administrator Jim Bridenstine later stated that the successful launch marked a new chapter in American excellence, bringing us once again closer to carrying American astronauts from American soil on American rockets.  Since the retirement of the Space Shuttle in 2011, the United States has been unable to use its own rockets to transport astronauts to space on its own. NASA is working with private companies to develop the future of human spaceflight.  Currently, SpaceX and NASA have a contract value of $2.6 billion, and Boeing is $4.2 billion.

passages.title: The launch of the spacecraft Crew Dragon (Crew-2) with astronauts to the ISS due to the weather was postponed to April 23
passages.passage: NASA and SpaceX announced the postponement of the launch of the mission to change the crew of the ISS Crew-2, also known as USCV-2 (US Crew Vehicle 2): it was shifted by only one day — on April 23.  The reason for the transfer is adverse weather conditions.  Launch Update @ NASA and @ SpaceX now are targeting Friday, April 23 at 5: 49 a.m.  ET for the launch of the Crew-2 mission to the @ Space _ Station due to unfavorable weather conditions along the flight path on Thursday.  Learn more: https: / / t.co / GSBum6JjfN pic.twitter.com / ylfQx0u2qT — NASA Commercial Crew (@ Commercial _ Crew) April 21, 2021 Estimated launch time of Crew-2 — 12: 49 Kyiv time.  First of all, the Crew-2 mission is distinguished by the fact that SpaceX uses the restored first stage of the Falcon 9 and the Crew Dragon spacecraft - the stage with the inventory number B1061.2, which launched the Crew-1 mission, and the C206 Endeavour spacecraft, which flew to the ISS as part of the first demo mission Demo-2.  And this will be the first manned flight on a rocket and a ship that has already flown into space.  In June 2020, NASA allowed SpaceX to reuse the Crew Dragon capsule and the first stage of the Falcon 9 rocket to deliver astronauts to the ISS.  The Crew-2 rocket and spacecraft have already passed all checks, they are installed vertically on the LC-39A launch pad at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.  Recall, the company of Elon Musk has long used already flying ships and the first stages of the Falcon 9 rocket to deliver cargo under the Commercial Resupply Services contract (in December 2017, the first launch took place as part of the CRS-13 mission, in which the launch vehicle and the ship were reused simultaneously - SpaceX maximum launched the same ship three times).  The current record for reusable Falcon 9 is nine restarts of the same first stage.  Crew-2 is SpaceX ’ s second full-time mission to send people to the ISS as part of its ongoing contact with NASA and its Commercial Crew Program, aimed at supporting commercial companies engaged in the development of space vehicles.  At least four more are planned.  The Crew-2 crew was announced back in July 2020 — two NASA astronauts (Robert Shane Kimbro and Catherine Megan MacArthur) and one each from ESA (Tom Pesquet) and JAXA (Akihiko Hoshide) will go to the ISS.  They will be part of the ISS-65 / 66 expedition.  The duration of this mission will be 180 days.  On April 5, 2020, NASA and SpaceX successfully redocked the Crew Dragon spacecraft of the Crew-1 mission for the first time from the IDA-1 docking node to IDA-3 to make room for the Crew-2 mission spacecraft.  After sending the Crew-1 crew to the IDA-3 node, Cargo Dragon 2 will dock.  When Crew-2 arrives on the ISS, the crew of the station until May 9 will consist of 11 people.  The current record is 13.  It has been holding since July 2009, when the space shuttle Endeavour (STS-127) arrived on the ISS.

passages.title: SpaceX successfully sent two astronauts into space as part of the Demo-2 mission » DailyTechInfo
passages.passage: On May 30, 2020, at 19: 22 GMT, the famous American space company SpaceX successfully launched a manned mission Demo-2.  The Crew Dragon spacecraft, which now holds two astronauts, Robert Behnken and Douglas Hurley, was launched into space by a Falcon 9 rocket launched from Launch Complex 39A at NASA ’ s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.  The spacecraft is currently in space, performing maneuvers that will lead it to the International Space Station (ISS), docking with which will be made during today, May 31, 2020.Yesterday's launch was made after the first attempt, scheduled for Wednesday last week, was postponed due to the approach of the storm front, carrying strong wind, rain and an increased risk of lightning strike.  By the time of the delayed launch, the weather had improved significantly, but NASA weather forecasters still gave a 50 percent chance of re-carrying the launch.  The Crew Dragon spacecraft successfully entered orbit, which was a mark of two significant events at once.  The Demo-2 mission was the first manned mission launched from the United States since 2011, when NASA retired its fleet of space shuttles.  And the second event was that the Demo-2 mission is the world ’ s first commercial mission, in which a spacecraft with astronauts on board was put into orbit. If the Demo-2 mission is successfully carried out until the very end, then SpaceX will begin to carry out regular flights to the ISS, delivering astronauts and various cargoes back to Earth.  And in conclusion, it should be noted that in the case of a successful docking of the Crew Dragon spacecraft with the space station, astronauts Robert Benken and Douglas Hurley will spend on board it from one to three months, after which they will return to Earth.

passages.title: The launch of the ship Crew Dragon – NASA flight: date, all that is known
passages.passage: Already this week, SpaceX ’ s Crew Dragon spacecraft will go to the ISS as part of the Demo-2 test mission.  The launch will mark the return of the United States to manned flights, which ended with the closure of the Space Shuttle program in 2011.  How the mission will take place and why it is important, we tell in our material.  Channel 24 closely followed the process of preparation for the manned launch of the manned spacecraft Crew Dragon.  We decided to collect all the details and interesting points in one article so that you could get acquainted with the key stages of the mission.  Do not miss the US returning to the ISS: SpaceX and NASA have revealed the details of the historic mission What is happening The United States of America is returning to manned flights to the ISS using its own ships.  Already this week, on May 27, the first ever manned launch of a spacecraft to the ISS, carried out by a private company SpaceX, will take place.  Crew Dragon will have two American astronauts on board.  After launch, the ship docks with the International Space Station at an altitude of 400 kilometers above the surface of the planet.  The astronauts will get to the station, where they will continue their mission, the duration of which is not yet known and will depend on a number of factors, both during the launch and during the flight of the ship until the moment of docking with the ISS.  Despite the fact that the flight is manned, and the mission of astronauts will take a lot of time on the ISS, it is still a test, so it is called Demo-2.  Previously, SpaceX has already tested the ship Crew Dragon, but this time the company will do it for the first time as part of a crewed mission.  The broadcast of the flight will take place on Techno 24.  So visit our website on May 27 at 23: 15.  The start is scheduled for 23: 30 in Kiev.  In addition, the broadcast will be available here: NASA TV: YouTube; SpaceX: YouTube link to the broadcast will be available before launch.  The fact is that the manned launch of Demo-2 will be the first such launch from American soil in almost a decade.  The last manned spacecraft to perform such a mission was the Space Shuttle Atlantis, which landed on July 21, 2011 as part of the STS-135 mission.  After that, the shuttles to the ISS no longer flew, and NASA was forced to buy seats for its astronauts on the Russian Soyuz, which cost the United States a considerable amount.  It is worth paying attention to the fact that after the American shuttles stopped flying, Russia constantly raised the price of seats for American astronauts and other partners on board the Soyuz spacecraft.  As of today, one seat on the Soyuz costs NASA $90 million (in 2010 it cost about $30 million).  The Alpha Centauri portal notes that given the approximate prices of Russian state launch contracts, it turns out that NASA pays the entire ship and the full cost of launching as part of the mission, paying only for one of its astronauts.  According to the report of NASA OIG on the audit of the manned flight program / The Alpha Centauri Here are more interesting facts about the ISS: how to create a research bastion of humanity in space Commercial Crew Program A year before the last flight of the shuttle, NASA initiated the launch of the manned flight program.  Even then, the search for a replacement for space shuttles began, the launches of which were quite expensive for the state.  Then came the idea, which at that time was revolutionary and even strange: the delivery of astronauts to the ISS should be engaged in private space companies.  NASA in this scenario took over the control of the design and preparation for the launch and the payment of seats for astronauts.  Space Shuttle Atlantis 30 minutes after landing in the last flight of the program Finally, in 2014, two companies were selected that will continue to prepare and present manned ships that will be able to carry out the mission.  These companies are Boeing and SpaceX.  As for the first company, the launch of the Boeing Starliner was unsuccessful, despite the fact that the ship landed successfully.  The company was unable to ensure the docking of the ship with the ISS due to a number of errors.  Now Boeing is engaged in fixing all the problems and preparing for a new test launch, but for their money.  Boeing Starliner, after landing SpaceX in March 2020, successfully launched Crew Dragon, which has passed a number of tests and landed proving its ability to ensure the delivery of astronauts to the ISS.  After additional tests and final preparations, the ship was prepared for an important event - a manned launch, which will take place on May 27, 2020.  Crew Crew Dragon To the ISS will go two NASA astronauts: Robert "Bob" Benken and Douglas "Doug" Gurley.  Both of them were test pilots and together in 2000 got to NASA as part of the 18th selection of astronauts.  Robert "Bob" Benken and Douglas "Dag" Gurley / NASA As for Robert Benken, during his time at NASA, he took part in two missions of the shuttle Endeavour: STS-123 (2008) and STS-130 (2010).  As part of these missions, Benken had three spacewalks.  Astronaut Robert Benken During the Demo-2 flight, Robert Benken will take command of the flight stages that will be coordinated by the mission control center.  Douglas Gurley also participated in two missions of the shuttle Endevour on missions STS-127 (2009) and STS-135 (2011).  In both missions, Gurley was a shuttle pilot, and STS-135 was the last mission to complete the space shuttle program.  During the Demo-2 flight, Douglas Hurley will be the commander of the ship and responsible for all procedures related to the launch and landing of the Crew Dragon spacecraft.  As already noted, the launch of the Crew Dragon is scheduled for May 27.  It is worth noting that the mission can still be postponed.  The reasons for this may be, as detected at the last moment technical problems or the weather, which should be favorable not only at the launch site, but also throughout the flight path of the Falcon 9 rocket.  Because in these places must pass the splashdown of the crew, if something went wrong at the time of launch or flight.  The ship Crew Dragon / SpaceX Now it is known that if the launch does not take place on May 27, then it can be postponed both on May 30 and on May 31.  If everything goes according to plan and the ship successfully enters orbit, it will spend about 19 hours there.  This is necessary for additional tests and maneuvers as part of the test – Crew Dragon can get to the ISS much faster.  In orbit, the astronauts will check the operation of all systems, switch to manual control, perform several maneuvers and eventually experience how comfortable Crew Dragon is for sleeping.  Docking with the IDA-2 node of the Harmony module on the ISS is scheduled for May 28 at about 15: 39 UTC (18: 39 Kyiv time).  Before that, the astronauts will approach the ISS and conduct several maneuvers near the station.  It is worth noting that the entire docking process with the ISS will take place automatically.  Astronauts will observe the process and will be able to intercept control in case of an emergency.  After the crew of Crew Dragon will get to the station, he will meet with members of the 63rd expedition - Chris Cassidy, Anatoly Ivanishin and Ivan Wagner.  As noted at the beginning of the material, the duration of stay of astronauts on the ISS is still unknown.  It will finally be determined during the flight, taking into account the state of the Crew Dragon ship and the readiness of the next Crew Dragon capsule, which is already designed for flight as part of the first full-fledged mission.  Let me remind you that despite the manned flight, this is still a test flight.  In addition, NASA expects to keep Demo-2 in orbit for as long as possible.  It is necessary for that.  after returning to finish the certification of the ship and begin preparations for the next mission.  In general, Demo-2 has every chance to stay in orbit for up to 120 days.  Rehearsal of the launch of Demo-2 / SpaceX Here it is worth noting that this limitation is due to the peculiarity of the design of the Crew Dragon.  In particular, it is said about solar panels, which gradually deteriorate during their stay in orbit due to the concentration of atomic oxygen.  The next Crew Dragon ships already have a protective coating of silicon dioxide, which will allow them to stay in orbit for all 210 days.  Whatever it was, and after the expiration of their stay on the ISS, the astronauts will return to the ship, undock and land in the waters of the Atlantic Ocean near the coast of Florida.  There the crew of the ship and the capsule itself will pick up the ship SpaceX Navigator. passages.title: Tomorrow SpaceX will test the emergency rescue system of the Crew Dragon spacecraft in flight. This is the last major test before the first operational flight with astronauts on board
passages.passage: Tomorrow, January 18, SpaceX intends to make the final major test of Crew Dragon ahead of the long-awaited Demo-2 mission with the first operational flight of a crewed spacecraft to the ISS.  We are talking about those additional tests of the emergency rescue system (SAS) with the shooting of the capsule during the flight.  Of course, the launch will be broadcast online, and those who want to watch the broadcast will find it below in this note.  The carrier rocket itself with the ship is already installed at the site of the SLC-40 complex at Cape Canaveral and is waiting for the countdown; a suitable launch window for the launch of the rocket opens on January 18 at 15: 00 Kyiv time.  SpaceX will have four hours to conduct the launch; assess the weather conditions as favorable and state that the probability of a successful launch is 90%.  Falcon 9 and Crew Dragon went vertical and the crew access arm was extended last night ahead of tomorrow's in-flight demonstration of the spacecraft's launch escape system.  The four-hour launch window opens at 8: 00 a.m.  EST, 13: 00 UTC → https: / / t.co / gtC39uBC7z pic.twitter.com / dS6R3hCgZi — SpaceX (@ SpaceX) January 17, 2020 These tests are not a mandatory part of NASA ’ s Crew Dragon certification program, but SpaceX on its own initiative intends to conduct them to demonstrate the reliability of the SAS and even donate one Falcon 9 rockets - for the purity of the experiment with simulated accident, it is likely to be destroyed during the flight, and the capsule soon after firing parachutes and splashdown in the ocean.  The animation for tomorrow ’ s launch can be seen below.  @ SpaceX's uncrewed in-flight abort test is targeted for 8am ET on Jan. 18.  This test will show that the # CrewDragon can protect astronauts even in the unlikely event of an emergency during launch.  Currently, weather is 90% GO for the demonstration.  https: / / t.co / PgHZol6PQA pic.twitter.com / kWCq7IHiq1 — NASA Commercial Crew (@ Commercial _ Crew) January 15, 2020 Recall that the Crew Dragon ship is equipped with two types of propulsion systems (low and high pressure).  The first with sixteen Draco engines is designed for orbital maneuvers and orientation of the ship in space, and the second with eight SuperDraco engines is responsible for shooting and controlled landing of the rescue capsule in case of an emergency.  The first Pad Abort Test simulated a rocket crash before launch and shot off the capsule from the launch pad SpaceX held back in 2015, and at the end of the year passed static tests of the emergency rescue system Crew Dragon in a new configuration with rupture diaphragm valves in the pressurization tubes instead of titanium valves.  The improvement should prevent the very possibility of a repeat of the scenario that led to the crash in April.  Also not so long ago, in preparation for the Demo-2 mission, SpaceX successfully tested new parachutes for Crew Dragon.  A few weeks ago, Elon Musk shared a video with computer animation of the first manned flight of the Crew Dragon spacecraft to the ISS.  It is hardly worth saying how important for SpaceX and the entire world of cosmonautics is this launch, to which SpaceX has been going for eight long years.  Recall, Crew Dragon is being developed as part of NASA ’ s program to stimulate the development of private ships Commercial Crew Development to send American astronauts to the ISS and ensure independence in this matter from Russia.  After the closure of the Space Shuttle program in 2011, the only means of delivering crews to the International Space Station are the Russian Soyuz spacecraft.  It is noteworthy that on January 20, SpaceX plans to carry out the next launch of Falcon 9, sending into orbit another batch of 60 satellites as part of its own project of a global satellite Internet network of a new generation.  This year, SpaceX plans to begin providing communication services to its first customers, and full network deployment is scheduled for the mid-2020s.  In total, in 2020, SpaceX plans to make from 35 to 38 launches, of which at least 24 in the interests of the Starlink project.

passages.title: Roscosmos welcomed the launch of Crew Dragon
passages.passage: The launch of the manned spacecraft Crew Dragon opens a new stage in the world space program.  This statement was made by the Executive Director of the state Corporation “Roscosmos ” Sergey Krikalev.  “I would like to welcome our American colleagues.  [...] I am confident that the success of this mission will give us additional opportunities that will benefit the entire international program, "Krikalev said, a video posted on Roscosmos's Twitter account.  According to him, a new cycle of tests has begun - before the ship has already flown in an unmanned version, but today "an important and responsible option", when astronauts went into orbit.  "This opens a new stage in the manned program - the world manned program, the ISS program, where this ship flew, because we have new opportunities, new reserves," Krikalev said.  SpaceX launched the Demo-2 mission on its second attempt.  It became the first manned flight of a private spacecraft Crew Dragon, as well as the first orbital space flight launched from the United States since 2011.  The ship will take astronauts Bob Benken and Doug Hurley to the ISS.  The launch was an important event in the history of American astronautics.  The first reusable stage of the Falcon 9 rocket has already made a successful automatic landing on a floating platform in the Atlantic. Title: SpaceX successfully launches manned space capsule
Content: On Saturday, space exploration technology company SpaceX launched its first crew Dragon, a critical flight to prove to NASA the safety of astronauts in future flights.  The mission, called Demo-1, was launched on a Falcon 9 rocket from the Kennedy Air Center in California.  This space capsule does not carry a human, but a model of an astronaut called Ripley, wearing sensors to measure various indicators of the human body in the space capsule.  This is the first of two SpaceX test flights under NASA ’ s Commercial Crew Program. Demo-2 will be the first to fly with a human pilot, scheduled for July of this year.  According to NASA ’ s plan, SpaceX will be the first company to send astronauts into space since 2011.  NASA Administrator Jim Bridenstine later stated that the successful launch marked a new chapter in American excellence, bringing us once again closer to carrying American astronauts from American soil on American rockets.  Since the retirement of the Space Shuttle in 2011, the United States has been unable to use its own rockets to transport astronauts to space on its own. NASA is working with private companies to develop the future of human spaceflight.  Currently, SpaceX and NASA have a contract value of $2.6 billion, and Boeing is $4.2 billion.
